Pasai stood on the north coast of Sumatra, near the modern Lhokseumawe, as the first Muslim port of the Indonesian archipelago that left lasting records. Its founder Merah Silu took the name Sultan Malik al-Salih, and a tomb of 1297 at Samudra is inscribed wholly in Arabic. The hinterland supplied gold and forest produce, and by the end of the thirteenth century the harbour met ships from the Bay of Bengal with merchants of the archipelago. Marco Polo, calling at Samara, and Ibn Battuta both passed through.

Ibn Battuta stayed about two weeks in 1345 in the wooden-walled town as a guest of the sultan, whom he praised as a devout follower of the Shafi'i school; the sultan then sent him on to China in one of his own junks. Pasai was then the easternmost land ruled by a Muslim. Majapahit raided it in the middle of the fourteenth century, and after about 1400 Malacca drew away much of its trade. The Portuguese, who knew the port as Pacem, occupied it in 1521, ten years after taking Malacca. Their garrison withdrew in 1524, and Ali Mughayat Syah of Aceh annexed the territory.
simp_chinese:
八昔位于苏门答腊北岸，在今日的洛克肖马韦一带，是印度尼西亚群岛上第一个留下长久记载的穆斯林港口。创建者梅拉·西卢（Merah Silu）取名马立克·萨利赫苏丹，苏木都剌一座1297年的陵墓通篇刻着阿拉伯文。腹地出产黄金和森林物产，十三世纪末，港口已是孟加拉湾的船只与群岛商人会面之处。马可·波罗途经“萨马拉”，伊本·白图泰也曾来此。

1345年，伊本·白图泰在这座木墙环绕的城镇里作为苏丹的客人停留了约两周，称赞苏丹虔诚遵循沙斐仪学派；随后苏丹派自己的一艘大船送他前往中国。当时八昔是穆斯林统治的最东端。十四世纪中叶，满者伯夷曾劫掠此地；1400年前后起，马六甲吸走了它的大部分贸易。葡萄牙人称这里为帕塞姆（Pacem），在占领马六甲十年后的1521年占据了这座港口。1524年守军撤走，亚齐的阿里·穆加亚特·沙阿吞并了这片领土。

english: Pasaman lies at the northern edge of the Minangkabau highlands, where the Barisan Mountains give way to valleys leading towards the plains of eastern Sumatra. In the fourteenth century an inscription from the Rao area recorded the name of Bijayendrawarman, a prince of the Malayapura kingdom. Centuries later Rao was associated with Tuanku Rao, one of the religious leaders of the Padri movement, which brought conflict to the Minangkabau lands in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 帕萨曼位于米南加保高地北缘，巴里桑山脉在此过渡为通向苏门答腊东部平原的河谷。十四世纪，拉奥一带的一块铭文记载了马来亚普拉王国王子毗阇耶因陀罗跋摩的名字。数百年后，拉奥又与宗教领袖端姑拉奥相联系；他参与帕德里运动，十九世纪初这场运动使米南加保地区陷入冲突。

english:
Pasapkedjinawong, the Rideau River, takes its Anishinaabe name from the water passing between rocks. At its mouth a pair of falls drops into the Ottawa River; their curtain-like appearance gave the river its French name, Rideau. Above the falls, the river and its lakes formed part of an Indigenous route connecting the Ottawa and St Lawrence waterways.

After the War of 1812, British planners sought an inland route less exposed to attack from the United States. Under Lieutenant-Colonel John By, workers built locks, dams and channels along the Rideau and the lakes to the south, linking existing waters into a continuous passage. The canal opened in 1832, joining the Ottawa River to Lake Ontario at Kingston and changing the course of travel through the district.
simp_chinese:
帕萨普克吉纳旺即里多河，其阿尼希纳贝语名称意为穿过岩石之间的河流。河口处，两道瀑布落入渥太华河，水幕的形状使河流得名法语的 Rideau，即“帷幕”。瀑布上游的河流和湖泊是原住民连接渥太华河与圣劳伦斯河水系的路线之一。

1812年战争后，英国当局寻求一条较少暴露于美国进攻的内陆路线。约翰·拜中校主持工人在里多河及南方湖区修建船闸、水坝和航道，将原有水域连成一条连续航路。运河于1832年通航，连接渥太华河与金斯顿的安大略湖，改变了这一带的交通。

english: Pasca lies in a narrow valley on the western slope of the Eastern Cordillera, near the high páramos of Sumapaz. Before Spanish rule, the district included the Indigenous communities of Pasca and Chiayzaque, in a region associated with the Sutagao and Fusagasugá peoples. Its position brought the highlands of the Bogotá plain into contact with the warmer country farther south. Colonial authorities grouped Pasca and Chiayzaque together in an Indigenous resguardo by the end of the sixteenth century. A church was built for the two communities in 1579 and replaced in 1604 on the orders of the official Luis Enríquez. The shared church became a focus for the colonial settlement, while the resguardo preserved a defined territory for its Indigenous inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 帕斯卡坐落在东科迪勒拉山脉西坡的一条狭窄谷地，靠近苏马帕斯高寒草原。西班牙统治以前，这一地区有帕斯卡和奇艾萨克等原住民社区，与苏塔高及富萨加苏加人所在地区相邻。这里使波哥大平原高地与更南方温暖地区相接。 十六世纪末，殖民当局将帕斯卡和奇艾萨克合为一处原住民保留地。1579年，两社区共用的教堂建成；1604年，官员路易斯·恩里克斯下令另建新堂。教堂成为殖民聚落的中心，保留地则为原住民划定了共同的土地。

english: The Pascagoula River flows through the lowlands of southeastern Mississippi into the waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Its name comes from Choctaw and means “bread people.” The lower river is also known as the Singing River, a name connected in local legend with a tragic story about the Pascagoula and their Biloxi neighbours. Forests and wetlands border the winding waterway on its way to the coast.
simp_chinese: 帕斯卡古拉河流经密西西比东南部低地，注入墨西哥湾。河名来自乔克托语，意为“面包之民”。下游又称歌唱河；当地传说将这个名称与帕斯卡古拉人及邻近比洛克西人之间的悲剧故事联系起来。河流蜿蜒向海，岸边分布着森林和湿地。

english: Paser lies on the southeastern side of Borneo, where rivers descend toward the Makassar Strait. Local traditions recall a kingdom called Sadurengas, later associated with the Sultanate of Paser, in this river country. Its history brings together the Paser people and Muslim influences reaching the coast. Accounts of its ruling family tell of marriage ties that helped bring Islam into the kingdom's political life.
simp_chinese: 帕塞尔位于婆罗洲东南侧，河流从这里流向望加锡海峡。当地传统记得这片河流地区有一座称为萨杜伦加斯的王国，后来与帕塞尔苏丹国联系起来。其历史交织着帕塞尔人和抵达海岸的穆斯林影响。有关统治家族的记述讲述了促使伊斯兰教进入王国政治生活的婚姻联系。

english: Pashash lies near Cabana in the northern Peruvian highlands. Its stone buildings and sculptures belong to the Recuay cultural tradition, which flourished in the mountains of Áncash before the rise of the Inca Empire. Sculptors carved figures and decorated stone slabs, while potters made fine vessels and artisans worked metal. The site was one of several centres whose architecture and imagery reveal connections among highland communities across the region.
simp_chinese: 帕沙什位于秘鲁北部高地卡瓦纳附近。石砌建筑与雕刻属于雷夸伊文化传统，这一文化在印加帝国兴起之前曾在安卡什山区繁盛。石匠雕刻人物与石板，陶工制作精美器皿，工匠也加工金属。帕沙什是多个地方中心之一，其建筑和图像体现了这一地区高地社群之间的联系。

sources.title: Museos y sitios arqueológicos de AncashH.pdf

english: Pashino lies on the left bank of the Angara near the mouth of the Pashina River. The great Angara flows west from Lake Baikal to the Yenisei, cutting across the wooded plateau of central Siberia. Its tributaries enter from a country of forests and hills, and their mouths provide landmarks along the long river route. Pashino takes its name from one such tributary.
simp_chinese: 帕希诺位于安加拉河左岸，靠近帕希纳河汇入口。安加拉河从贝加尔湖向西流向叶尼塞河，横穿中西伯利亚的森林高原。支流从森林与丘陵之间汇入，河口成为漫长水道上的地标；帕希诺便得名于其中一条支流。

english: Pasho lies in the deep mountain valleys of eastern Tibet. The surrounding ranges cast a rain shadow over parts of the district, giving its sheltered gorge a drier climate than many eastern Tibetan valleys. Pasho Monastery became a Gelug centre of worship and learning in this country of steep slopes and high passes. The monastery was founded in 1473 by Lhopa Gyeltsen Sengge, a disciple of Tsongkhapa. It became the seat of the Tatsak Jedrung incarnation lineage, whose members were eligible to serve as regents during the minority of the Dalai Lamas. In 1794 a regency temple, Kundeling, was founded in Lhasa, linking the Pasho lineage to the government of central Tibet.
simp_chinese: 八宿位于藏地东部的深山峡谷。周围山脉形成雨影，使部分避风峡谷比许多藏东谷地干燥。八宿寺是这片陡坡与高山口之间的格鲁派礼佛和学问中心。1473年，宗喀巴弟子洛巴坚赞森格创建八宿寺。寺院成为达察杰仲活佛世系的驻锡地，其成员有资格在达赖喇嘛年幼时担任摄政。1794年，拉萨建立摄政寺院功德林，将八宿的传承与卫藏政权联系起来。

english: Pashozero stands by the lake from which the Pasha flows west toward the Svir. The church district at the lake is named in a 1583 survey as the St Nicholas pogost on the Pasha. Its inhabitants also appear in birch-bark letters sent from the Tikhvin country to Novgorod, evidence of older ties across the wooded region. Villages and their church centre stood among the lakes and rivers that feed the waters south of Lake Onega.
simp_chinese: 帕绍泽罗坐落在湖畔，帕沙河从这里流出，向西注入斯维里河。1583年的调查将湖边的教堂辖区记作帕沙河上的圣尼古拉教堂村。从季赫温地区寄往诺夫哥罗德的桦树皮文书中，也提到了这个教堂辖区的居民，显示出穿越森林的更古老联系。村庄和教堂中心散布在湖河之间，这些水流最终汇入奥涅加湖以南的水系。

english: Pasni is a fishing port on the Makran coast, facing the Arabian Sea between Gwadar and Ormara. The surrounding shore is dry and sparsely settled, with rocky hills rising behind stretches of beach. Its bay is among the few natural anchorages on a coast otherwise exposed to the sea. Fishing has long been an important occupation along this littoral, where communities look outward to the water as well as inland across the difficult ranges of Makran.
simp_chinese: 帕斯尼是马克兰海岸的渔港，位于瓜达尔与奥尔马拉之间，面向阿拉伯海。周围海岸干旱、人烟稀少，岩山在沙滩后方升起。当地海湾是这片多向海洋敞开的海岸上少数天然锚地之一。捕鱼长期是沿岸重要的生计，居民既面向海洋，也与马克兰崎岖山脉另一侧的内陆保持联系。

english:
Paspébiac stands on Chaleur Bay, where a long sandbar shelters a harbour and provides beaches for drying fish. Its shores became a centre of the cod trade linking the Gaspé coast to markets across the Atlantic. The fishing bank offered both a protected anchorage and space to cure the catch brought in from the gulf.

In 1766 Charles Robin, a merchant from Jersey in the Channel Islands, surveyed the bay and chose Paspébiac for a fishing post. The following year he erected a dwelling and store; after the interruption caused by war, he returned in 1783 to direct a new company. By the early nineteenth century the Robin establishment included warehouses, workshops and a wharf, supporting the preparation and export of dried cod.
simp_chinese:
帕斯佩比亚克位于沙勒尔湾，一条长沙洲为港湾提供掩护，也为晾晒鱼货提供海滩。这里成为鳕鱼贸易中心，将加斯佩海岸与大西洋彼岸的市场联系起来。渔场既有避风锚地，也有加工海湾渔获的空间。

1766年，泽西岛商人查尔斯·罗宾考察海湾，选中帕斯佩比亚克设立渔业站。次年他建起住所和货栈；战争使经营中断后，他于1783年返回，领导一家新公司。到十九世纪初，罗宾的设施已包括仓库、工场和码头，为干鳕鱼的加工与出口服务。

english: Pasrur lies in the Punjab plain near Sialkot. It was founded during the reign of the Mughal emperor Babur by Chaudhry Matika Bajwa, a Jat. Near the town are the remains of a bridge built by Shah Daula, recalling the roads and crossings that linked Pasrur with the surrounding settlements of the Punjab.
simp_chinese: 帕萨鲁尔位于旁遮普平原，靠近锡亚尔科特。莫卧儿皇帝巴布尔在位时，贾特人乔德里·马蒂卡·巴杰瓦建立了此城。城镇附近留有沙·道拉修建的一座桥的遗迹，让人想起连接帕萨鲁尔与旁遮普周围聚落的道路和渡口。

english:
At the head of navigation on the Penobscot River, the site of Bangor joins tidal water to the forested interior of northern Maine. The Penobscot call the area Kenduskeag, a name referring to water parsnips. The river gave access to the woods upstream and a route down to the Atlantic, making the place a natural centre for the timber trade.

Jacob Buswell established a settlement here in 1769, and by 1772 it had a sawmill, a store and a school. It became the town of Bangor in 1791. During the American Revolution, vessels retreating after the failed Penobscot Expedition were scuttled nearby to prevent their capture by the British. British forces occupied Bangor briefly in 1814, during the War of 1812 with the United States.
simp_chinese:
班戈位于佩诺布斯科特河通航的上限，是潮汐水域与森林内陆相接之处。佩诺布斯科特人称此地为肯杜斯基格，其名称与水芹有关。河流通向上游的林地，也向下游连接大西洋，使这里成为木材贸易的天然中心。

雅各布·巴斯韦尔于1769年在此建立聚落，到1772年已有锯木场、商店和学校。1791年，这里建镇并取名班戈。美国独立战争期间，佩诺布斯科特远征失败后撤退的船只在附近自沉，以免落入英军之手。1812年战争期间，英军曾于1814年短暂占领班戈。

english: The Passamaquoddy are a Wabanaki people whose homeland encompasses Passamaquoddy Bay, the St Croix River and their surrounding waters. Their own name, Peskotomuhkati, refers to spearing pollock, a fish of importance to their people. Traditionally, families dispersed inland to hunt in winter and gathered more closely along the coast and islands in summer, harvesting fish, shellfish and marine mammals.
simp_chinese: 帕萨马科迪人是瓦巴纳基民族之一，其家园包括帕萨马科迪湾、圣克罗伊河及周围水域。他们的自称佩斯科托穆卡蒂与用矛捕捉狭鳕有关，这种鱼是族人重要的食物。按照传统，家庭冬季分散到内陆狩猎，夏季则更多地聚集在海岸和岛屿，捕捞鱼类、贝类及海洋哺乳动物。

english:
Passau stands where the Inn and the Ilz join the Danube, earning it the name of the Three Rivers City. Roman forts once guarded the meeting of the waters, and in 739 Boniface founded the bishopric of Passau. Its diocese grew to encompass much of Bavaria and Austria, while from the tenth century its bishops also exercised secular authority over the city and its surroundings.

In 1552 the Treaty of Passau brought an agreement between Ferdinand, acting for Emperor Charles V, and the Protestant princes; the religious question was to be submitted to an imperial diet, leading to the Peace of Augsburg three years later. The city's smiths were famed for their swords, often stamped with the Passau wolf, a mark believed by some soldiers to protect its bearer. A great fire consumed much of Passau in 1662, after which the city was rebuilt in the Baroque style. The prince-bishopric was secularised in 1803.
simp_chinese:
帕绍坐落在因河、伊尔茨河与多瑙河的交汇处，因而得名“三河之城”。罗马堡垒曾守卫这处汇流地，七三九年博尼法斯在此建立帕绍主教区。教区后来扩展至巴伐利亚和奥地利广大地区；十世纪起，主教也对城市及其周边行使世俗权力。

一五五二年的《帕绍条约》使代表皇帝查理五世的斐迪南与新教诸侯达成协议，将宗教问题提交帝国议会；三年后双方缔结《奥格斯堡和约》。帕绍铁匠以铸剑闻名，剑身常刻有帕绍狼的标记，一些士兵相信它能保护持剑者。一六六二年大火吞噬了城中大部分建筑，此后城市以巴洛克风格重建。采邑主教国于一八〇三年世俗化。

english: Passavant stands above the upper Layon on the southern edge of Anjou, facing the country of Poitou. The counts of Anjou established a stronghold here in the eleventh century, and the castle's stone buildings guarded a route across the frontier between the two regions. During the Hundred Years' War an English garrison occupied Passavant in 1359 and 1360; the Treaty of Brétigny provided for its withdrawal. The castle and the village below it remained a reminder of the fortified border country through which armies had passed.
simp_chinese: 帕萨旺位于安茹南缘、拉永河上游高地，面向普瓦图。安茹伯爵于十一世纪在此建立据点，城堡石建筑守卫穿越两地边界的道路。百年战争期间，英军驻军于 1359 和 1360 年占据帕萨旺，《布勒丁尼条约》规定其撤离。城堡与下方村庄让人想起军队曾经穿行的设防边境地区。

english: Passo Fundo lies on the southern Brazilian plateau, amid grasslands crossed by rivers and routes linking the missions with the north. During the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries drovers carried cattle and mules through this country towards São Paulo. In 1828 Manoel José das Neves established the Fazenda Nossa Senhora da Conceição, a nucleus of the later settlement. Yerba mate and cattle were among the resources of the surrounding uplands.
simp_chinese: 帕苏丰杜位于巴西南部高原，河流和连接传教区与北方的道路穿过草原。十八世纪至十九世纪初，赶牲畜者经此将牛和骡子运往圣保罗。1828年，曼努埃尔·若泽·达斯内维斯建立圣母无原罪庄园，成为后来聚落的核心。马黛茶和牲畜是周围高地的资源之一。

english: Passos developed in southern Minas Gerais in country that attracted farmers and prospectors to the Rio Grande valley. The early settlement was known as Capoeira. A chapel dedicated to Senhor Bom Jesus dos Passos became the centre of the growing community in the 1830s, giving it a new name. Cultivation, cattle raising and the search for gold all contributed to the occupation of the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 帕苏斯兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯南部，里奥格兰德河谷吸引了农民和寻矿者来到这一带。早期聚落称为卡波埃拉。十九世纪三十年代，一座供奉受难善耶稣的小教堂成为不断成长的社区中心，并为聚落带来新的名字。耕作、牧牛与寻金共同推动了周围乡村的殖民定居。

english: Passu lies beside the Hunza River in the high valley of Gojal, beneath the sharp peaks of the Karakoram. The Passu and Batura glaciers descend towards the valley, while the pointed ridge of Tupopdan rises above the river. Farther north, the routes through Misgar reach the Kilik and Mintaka passes, once used by caravans travelling between the upper Indus and the lands around Tashkurgan.
simp_chinese: 帕苏位于戈贾尔高谷的罕萨河畔，喀喇昆仑尖峭山峰耸立在上方。帕苏冰川和巴图拉冰川向谷地伸展，图波普丹的尖峰山脊俯瞰河流。向北经过米斯加尔的道路通往基里克和明铁盖山口，过去商队经此往返印度河上游与塔什库尔干周边地区。

english: The Passumpsic River flows through the wooded hills of northeastern Vermont to meet the Connecticut. Its valley became a route south for some of Robert Rogers's rangers in 1759, after their attack on the Abenaki settlement at St. Francis. The raiders divided into groups on their difficult retreat, and Rogers himself led men toward the river's mouth. The attack and retreat took place during the war between Britain and France for control of North America.
simp_chinese: 帕桑普西克河流经佛蒙特东北部林木覆盖的丘陵，汇入康涅狄格河。1759年，罗伯特·罗杰斯率领的游骑兵袭击阿贝纳基人的圣弗朗西斯聚落后，部分人在艰难撤退中沿此河谷南行。袭击者分成几队，罗杰斯本人带着一些人前往河口。这次袭击与撤退发生在英国和法国争夺北美控制权的战争期间。

english: Pastol Bay lies at the northern edge of the Yukon delta, where the Apoon mouth of the river meets Norton Sound. The Pastolik and Pastoliak rivers enter this shallow coastal country, threading through low tundra and wetlands. The Yup'ik settlement of Pastolik stood near the rivers and was one of the trading centres between the Yukon and Norton Sound. Long before Russian posts appeared, goods passed through a network that reached the Bering Strait and Siberia.
simp_chinese: 帕斯托尔湾位于育空河三角洲北缘，阿蓬河口在此汇入诺顿湾。帕斯托利克河与帕斯托利亚克河穿过低平苔原和湿地，流入这片浅海。尤皮克人的帕斯托利克聚落位于河流附近，是育空河与诺顿湾之间的贸易中心之一。早在俄国据点出现以前，货物就已通过贸易网络传往白令海峡和西伯利亚。

english: Pasukhdin was an Osage village name, remembered both as an ancient name and as that of a later settlement on the Verdigris River. The Osage lived in villages along rivers between the wooded Ozarks and the open plains, planting crops as well as undertaking seasonal hunts. Their communities maintained connections across the Arkansas and Missouri river basins, a wide homeland traversed by tributaries such as the Verdigris and Neosho.
simp_chinese: 帕苏克丁是奥塞奇村落的名称，既见于古老的村名，也用于后来位于弗迪格里斯河畔的一处聚落。奥塞奇人沿奥扎克森林与开阔平原之间的河流建村，种植作物并进行季节性狩猎。各社群在阿肯色河和密苏里河流域保持联系，弗迪格里斯河与尼奥肖河等支流穿过这片广阔的故土。

english: Pasvalys grew near the meeting of the Svalia and Lėvuo in northern Lithuania. A church built in 1497–1498 helped establish the settlement as a local centre. In 1557 it became the setting for negotiations between Grand Duke Sigismund Augustus and Wilhelm von Fürstenberg, master of the Livonian Order. Their agreements settled an immediate dispute and brought Lithuania and Livonia closer together against Moscow. Ivan IV used the treaties as a pretext for invading Livonia the following year, opening the long Livonian War.
simp_chinese: 帕斯瓦利斯兴起于立陶宛北部斯瓦利亚河与莱沃河的汇合处附近。1497至1498年修建的教堂帮助聚落成为地方中心。1557年，立陶宛大公齐格蒙特·奥古斯特与利沃尼亚骑士团团长威廉·冯·菲尔斯滕贝格在此谈判。他们达成的协议解决了眼前的争端，并使立陶宛与利沃尼亚在对抗莫斯科的问题上更为接近。次年伊凡四世以这些条约为借口入侵利沃尼亚，漫长的利沃尼亚战争由此开始。

english:
Patagonia stretches across the southern end of South America, from the Andean icefields to the dry plateaus and Atlantic coast. The eastern steppe is a land of strong winds and guanacos, while the mountains capture moisture arriving from the Pacific. Indigenous peoples, including the Aonikenk, lived and travelled across these contrasting landscapes long before Europeans reached the southern coast.

In 1520 Ferdinand Magellan’s expedition wintered at San Julián and met local inhabitants whom its chronicler called Patagones. The name subsequently came to be applied to the wider region. European ships continued to visit the coast and the strait that Magellan crossed later that year, but the interior remained the home of Indigenous communities whose territories and routes extended across the plateau.
simp_chinese:
巴塔哥尼亚横跨南美洲最南端，从安第斯冰原延伸到干燥的高原和大西洋海岸。东部草原风势强劲，原驼出没其间；山脉则截留来自太平洋的水汽。包括奥尼肯克人在内的原住民早在欧洲人抵达南方海岸之前，便已生活并往来于这些迥异的景观之中。

1520年，麦哲伦船队在圣胡利安湾过冬，遇见了当地居民；随行记录者称他们为巴塔贡人，这一名称后来被用于更广阔的地区。此后欧洲船只继续到访海岸和海峡，但内陆仍是原住民社区的家园，他们的领地与道路遍布高原。

english:
Patan, once called Anhilavada, was a great capital of Gujarat on the Saraswati River. Under the Chaulukya rulers it became a centre of commerce, learning and temple patronage. Its most celebrated monument is Rani ki Vav, an immense stepwell attributed to Queen Udayamati in memory of King Bhima I. Descending through storeys of carved pillars and galleries towards the water, the well is adorned with hundreds of sculptures of deities and celestial figures.

Jain scholars and merchants played an important part in the city’s life. The scholar Hemachandra served at the Chaulukya court and composed works on grammar, poetry and religion. After the Delhi Sultanate conquered Gujarat at the end of the thirteenth century, Patan remained an administrative centre. Early Gujarat sultans ruled from the city before Ahmad Shah founded Ahmedabad as his new capital in 1411. Though political power shifted, Patan retained its temples, stepwells and traditions of fine craftsmanship. Its patterned patola textiles, made using a demanding double-ikat technique, became renowned far beyond Gujarat.
simp_chinese:
帕坦旧称安希拉瓦达，曾是萨拉斯瓦蒂河畔的古吉拉特大都。遮娄其统治时期，这里成为商业、学术和神庙赞助的中心。最著名的纪念建筑是拉妮阶井，相传由乌达亚玛蒂王后为纪念比摩一世建造。阶井层层下降，穿过雕柱和廊道通向水面，数百尊神祇与天界人物雕像装饰其间。

耆那教学者与商人在城市生活中占有重要地位。学者诃摩旃陀罗曾服务于遮娄其宫廷，撰写语法、诗歌和宗教著作。十三世纪末德里苏丹国征服古吉拉特后，帕坦仍是行政中心。早期古吉拉特苏丹从此统治，直到1411年艾哈迈德沙阿创建新都艾哈迈达巴德。虽然政治中心迁移，帕坦保留了神庙、阶井和精湛的工艺传统。当地采用复杂双重扎染技术织成的帕托拉花纹织物，也远在古吉拉特之外享有盛名。

english:
The tidal waters of the Patapsco form Baltimore's harbour, opening onto the Chesapeake Bay. The river's name is of Algonquian origin and may refer to a rocky point near its mouth. Beyond the harbour, the river winds inland through a valley where mills used its water to grind grain and power workshops.

Maryland established a port here for the tobacco trade in 1706, and Baltimore was founded in 1729. The town grew as merchants shipped grain and tobacco to the Caribbean. During the War of 1812, British forces bombarded Fort McHenry at the harbour entrance; Francis Scott Key watched the attack and wrote the poem that became “The Star-Spangled Banner.” The Baltimore and Ohio Railroad began carrying goods inland from the port in 1830.
simp_chinese:
帕塔普斯科河的潮汐水域构成巴尔的摩港，向切萨皮克湾敞开。河名源于阿尔冈昆语，可能指河口附近一处突出的岩石。港口以上，河流蜿蜒深入内陆，河谷里的磨坊利用水力磨粮并驱动作坊。

马里兰当局于1706年在此设港，供烟草贸易使用，巴尔的摩镇则于1729年建立。随着商人将粮食和烟草运往加勒比地区，城镇迅速成长。1812年战争期间，英军炮轰港口入口的麦克亨利堡；弗朗西斯·斯科特·基目睹战斗，写下后来成为《星条旗之歌》的诗篇。1830年，巴尔的摩与俄亥俄铁路开始在港口和内陆之间运输货物。

english: The Patarabueye were settled peoples of La Junta de los Ríos, where the Río Conchos meets the Rio Grande. Their villages stood along both rivers amid the dry country of northern Mexico and western Texas. Fields along the waterways supported farming communities, while other peoples visited the junction to trade or settle seasonally. Spanish expeditions in the sixteenth century encountered these villages and recorded several names for their inhabitants, including Patarabueye and Conchos. La Junta remained a meeting place of diverse peoples on the northern frontier.
simp_chinese: 帕塔拉布耶是拉洪塔德洛斯里奥斯的定居居民，孔乔河在这里汇入格兰德河。他们的村庄沿两河分布，周围是墨西哥北部和得克萨斯西部的干旱地区。水道旁的田地支持农业社群，其他民族也到河流交汇处贸易或季节性居住。十六世纪的西班牙远征队见到这些村庄，为居民记录下帕塔拉布耶、孔乔等不同名称。拉洪塔长期是北方边疆不同民族的相会之地。

english:
Patawomeck was both a people and their principal town on a peninsula between the Potomac River and Potomac Creek. They cultivated maize and drew on the fish and game of the river country. John Smith visited in 1608, recording extensive fields along the Potomac. The name of the town was written in several forms, including Potomac. Loosely allied with the Powhatan Confederacy, the Patawomeck also maintained relations with English settlers.

In 1613 the English captain Samuel Argall seized Pocahontas while she was among the Patawomeck. The people continued to deal with the English, but settler encroachment brought growing conflict. In 1665 the colonial government compelled them to sell their remaining land; the following year it declared war on several peoples of the Northern Neck, including the Patawomeck.
simp_chinese:
帕塔沃梅克既是一个族群的名称，也是他们主要城镇的名字。城镇位于波托马克河与波托马克溪之间的半岛上。居民种植玉米，利用河流地区的鱼类和猎物。约翰·史密斯于1608年到访，记下了波托马克河沿岸大片的玉米田。城镇名称有多种拼法，其中包括波托马克。帕塔沃梅克人与波瓦坦联盟关系较为松散，也与英国移民往来。

1613年，英国船长塞缪尔·阿格尔趁波卡洪塔斯身在帕塔沃梅克人中间时将她抓走。此后帕塔沃梅克人继续与英国人交往，但移民侵占土地使冲突不断加剧。1665年，殖民政府强迫他们出售剩余土地；次年，政府向北颈半岛的几个族群宣战，其中就包括帕塔沃梅克人。

english: The Pataxó are an Indigenous people of southern Bahia, whose lands include the forests and coast near the Jequitinhonha River. Colonial settlement brought pressure and conflict, as newcomers sought land and established alliances with some Indigenous groups against others. Pataxó communities faced hostility from settlers and the advance of occupation through the country between the Atlantic coast and the interior.
simp_chinese: 帕塔肖人是巴伊亚南部的原住民族，他们的土地包括热基蒂尼奥尼亚河附近的森林和海岸。殖民定居带来了压力与冲突：外来者寻找土地，并与一些原住民群体结盟，对抗另一些群体。帕塔肖社区面对定居者的敌意，以及殖民占领在大西洋海岸与内陆之间的推进。

english: Patay is a name used by a Tonokoté community in the river country of Santiago del Estero. The Tonokoté inhabited the plains around the Dulce and Salado rivers before the Spanish founded Santiago del Estero in 1553. Along these watercourses, settlements and cultivation occupied a dry region of woodland and seasonal floods. Indigenous communities continued to live in the area throughout the colonial period, despite the demands of the new colonial authorities.
simp_chinese: 帕塔伊是圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗河流地区一个托诺科特社群使用的名称。西班牙人于1553年建立圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗之前，托诺科特人已生活在杜尔塞河与萨拉多河周围的平原上。河岸聚落和耕地分布于林地与季节性洪水交错的干燥地区；尽管殖民当局提出各种要求，原住民社群在殖民时代继续居住于此。

english: Patchepawapoka is a Cree name borne by a river and lake in the lowlands west of James Bay. The river reaches a coast fringed by wide marshes, between the Ekwan and Lakitusaki rivers. In the surrounding lowlands, Cree families moved inland in winter to hunt caribou in the forest. As the animals migrated in spring, hunters could use fences and snares where their paths crossed frozen rivers.
simp_chinese: 帕切帕瓦波卡是詹姆斯湾西部低地一条河流和一座湖的克里语名称。河流通往埃克万河与拉基图萨基河之间的海岸，岸边分布着宽阔沼泽。周围低地的克里家庭冬天进入内陆森林猎取驯鹿；春天兽群迁徙时，猎人可在它们穿越冰封河流的地方设置围栏与陷阱。

english: Pate is a Swahili town on an island in the Lamu archipelago, sheltered by channels and mangrove shores. Its rulers presided over a maritime community linked to the East African mainland and the wider Indian Ocean. Stone houses, mosques and the remembered chronicles of its ruling families testify to the island's long place in the coastal world. Pate grew in importance after the middle of the sixteenth century, drawing strength from alliances with communities on the mainland as well as regional trade. In the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries its sultanate became the leading power in the archipelago. Its rulers navigated the ambitions of Portuguese and Omani powers while competing with neighbouring towns for influence and access to commerce.
simp_chinese: 帕泰是拉穆群岛上的一座斯瓦希里城镇，水道和红树林海岸为岛屿提供庇护。统治者治理的海上社群与东非大陆及广阔的印度洋世界相连。石造住宅、清真寺和王族流传的编年史，见证了这座岛屿在海岸世界的悠久地位。十六世纪中叶以后，帕泰的重要性日益增长，既得益于区域贸易，也得益于与大陆社群的联盟。十七世纪至十八世纪初，其苏丹国成为群岛的主要势力。统治者在葡萄牙和阿曼势力的政治图谋之间周旋，同时与邻近城镇争夺影响力和贸易机会。

english:
The waters around Pate Island belong to the northern Swahili coast. Island towns participated in Indian Ocean commerce before Portuguese ships arrived, and monsoon winds connected East African ports with Arabia, the Persian Gulf and western India. Merchants exchanged African goods for imported cloth and ceramics, while fishing and cultivation supported coastal households.

The island contained several settlements, including Shanga, which was abandoned around 1400–1425. Pate became an important centre of the Lamu archipelago and the seat of a sultanate. Islam, coral stone architecture and the Swahili language expressed a coastal culture rooted in Africa and shaped by overseas relationships. Competition among neighbouring towns interacted with Portuguese and later Omani power. Channels, reefs and seasonal winds shaped how sailors approached the island and how its communities maintained connections across the western Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese:
帕泰岛周围海域属于斯瓦希里海岸北段。葡萄牙船只抵达之前，岛上城镇已参与印度洋贸易，季风将东非港口同阿拉伯、波斯湾和印度西岸相连。商人以非洲货物换取进口布匹和陶瓷，捕鱼与耕作则支撑沿海家庭的生活。

岛上曾有多个聚落，其中尚加约在1400至1425年间被废弃。帕泰后来成为拉穆群岛的重要中心和苏丹国所在地。伊斯兰教、珊瑚石建筑与斯瓦希里语体现了植根非洲、又受海外交往影响的海岸文化。邻近城镇之间的竞争与葡萄牙、后来阿曼势力的介入交织。水道、礁石和季风影响船只接近岛屿，也塑造岛民在西印度洋的联系。

english: Pātea lies near the mouth of a river on the southern Taranaki coast. Māori traditions tell of the arrival of the Aotea canoe here. At Waitore, just south of Pātea, archaeological finds include wooden objects decorated in eastern Polynesian styles, evidence of settlement in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 帕蒂亚位于塔拉纳基南岸一处河口附近。毛利传统讲述了奥特亚航海独木舟在此抵达的故事。帕蒂亚以南的怀托雷出土了带有东波利尼西亚式装饰的木器，显示十五世纪这里已有聚落。

english: Patgasa Wakpa, or Frog Creek, is a watercourse near the Missouri in the northern Plains. Its name recalls the frogs found along its banks. Assiniboine people used the surrounding country as a campsite while following the bison, and the creek joins the Missouri near the place later known as Wolf Point. The valley lies amid open prairie north of the great river.
simp_chinese: 帕特加萨瓦克帕，即蛙溪，是北部平原密苏里河附近的一条水道，名称使人想起河岸边的蛙群。阿西尼博因人在追随野牛时曾在附近扎营；溪流在后来称为沃尔夫波因特的地方附近注入密苏里河。河谷位于大河北岸的开阔草原之中。

english:
Pathankot stands at the northern edge of the Punjab plain, near the hills of Kangra. Coins of the ancient Audumbara kingdom have been found in the surrounding country, a region mentioned in the Mahabharata and in the work of the grammarian Panini. The Pathania Rajput clan takes its name from the town, also known as Paithan.

In the medieval period Pathankot was an early capital of the hill state later known as Nurpur. The Pathania rulers held the country between the Punjab plain and the hills until the expansion of Sikh power. Jai Singh Kanhaiya took Pathankot from them, and it was subsequently incorporated into the Punjab under Maharaja Ranjit Singh. His wife Moran lived in a fortress at Pathankot from 1811.
simp_chinese:
帕坦科特位于旁遮普平原北缘，靠近冈格拉山地。周围地区发现过古代奥敦巴拉王国的硬币；《摩诃婆罗多》和语法学家波你尼的著作都提到了这个地区。帕塔尼亚拉杰普特氏族得名于这座城，它也被称作佩坦。

中世纪时，帕坦科特是后来称作努尔布尔的山地王国的早期都城。帕塔尼亚统治者控制着旁遮普平原与山地之间的土地，直到锡克势力扩张。杰伊·辛格·坎海亚从他们手中夺取帕坦科特，此地随后在兰吉特·辛格大君统治下并入旁遮普。1811年起，大君的妻子莫兰居住在当地的一座堡垒中。

english: Patharkandi lies in the Barak valley country east of Sylhet, near the Longai River. The river descends through the hills and crosses the lowlands towards the larger waterways of the Surma and Kushiyara basin. Rainfall and seasonal floods shape the valley, while the neighbouring ridges mark the transition from the plains to the uplands of the eastern frontier.
simp_chinese: 帕塔尔坎迪位于锡尔赫特以东的巴拉克河谷地区，靠近隆盖河。河水从山地流下，穿过低地，通向苏尔马河与库希亚拉河流域更大的水道。降雨和季节性洪水塑造谷地，邻近山脊则标志着平原向东部边疆高地的过渡。

sources.title: Status of Trace and Toxic Metals in Rivers of India 9th edition 2025.pdf

english:
Pathein, known to English traders as Bassein, is a port on the western side of the Irrawaddy delta. Its river opens towards the Bay of Bengal, giving ships from the west access to the waterways of Lower Burma. The city appears in a Sri Lankan inscription of 1165 under the name Kusima, and served the rulers of Pagan and Ava as a maritime outlet. Merchants knew it by several names, including Cosmin.

In the late fourteenth century Pathein and Myaungmya were held by Laukpya, ruler of the delta, against King Razadarit of Hanthawaddy. Razadarit's victory in 1390 brought the ports under his authority. Pathein continued as an important western harbour even after Pegu controlled Lower Burma. Its position allowed goods and travellers to move between the Bay of Bengal and the river routes leading into the interior.
simp_chinese:
勃生位于伊洛瓦底江三角洲西侧，是英国商人所称的巴色因港。河道通向孟加拉湾，使来自西方的船只能够进入下缅甸水网。斯里兰卡一篇1165年的铭文以“古西摩”之名称及此地；蒲甘和阿瓦的统治者也将它作为海上出口。商人还以科斯明等不同名字称呼这座港口。

十四世纪末，三角洲统治者劳比亚据守勃生与渺弥亚，抵抗汉达瓦底国王罗娑陀利。1390年罗娑陀利获胜，将这些港口纳入统治。即使下缅甸归勃固管辖后，勃生仍是重要的西部港湾。它的位置使货物和旅人得以在孟加拉湾与通向内陆的河道之间往来。

english: Pathri lies in the Godavari country of the central Deccan, west of Parbhani. The town’s older history is connected with the Yadava rulers of Devagiri and the later powers that divided their lands. During a Mughal campaign against the Nizam Shahis in the early seventeenth century, forces retreating from Jalna passed through Pathri before seeking refuge at Dharur. In the eighteenth century the Nizam granted the Pathri district to Sultanji along with lands at Bid and Dharur.
simp_chinese: 帕特里位于德干中部的戈达瓦里河流域，处在帕尔巴尼以西。城镇早期历史与提婆吉里的耶达瓦统治者，以及后来瓜分其土地的诸政权有关。十七世纪初莫卧儿进攻尼扎姆沙王朝时，从贾尔纳撤退的军队经过帕特里，随后前往达鲁尔避难。十八世纪，尼扎姆将帕特里地区与比德、达鲁尔的土地一同授予苏丹吉。

english: Pati lies in the northern coastal country of Java, east of Mount Muria. Pati and neighbouring Juwana stood near an estuary that once separated the mountain from the mainland. Their rulers competed with Demak and Jepara for the trade of the north coast, though the western ports ultimately gained the upper hand. After Demak's power broke apart in the sixteenth century, the ruler of Pajang granted Pati to his captain Ki Panjawi. His successors, remembered as the Pragolas, ruled a principality whose ties with the rising house of Mataram were at first close. As Mataram's ambitions grew, those relations deteriorated, and Pati became involved in the struggles through which the inland kingdom sought control of the coastal states.
simp_chinese: 帕蒂位于爪哇北部沿海地区，居穆里亚山以东。帕蒂与邻近的朱瓦纳靠近一处河口；这片水域淤塞以前，曾将山地与爪哇本岛分开。当地统治者与淡目、杰帕拉争夺北岸贸易，最终西面的港口占了上风。十六世纪淡目的权势瓦解后，巴章统治者将帕蒂授予其将领基·潘查维。他的继承者被记作帕拉戈拉，统治一个与新兴马打兰王室起初关系密切的地方政权。随着马打兰野心增长，双方关系恶化，帕蒂卷入了这个内陆王国争夺沿海诸国的斗争。

english:
The Patía River cuts through a dry valley between the Andean ranges of southwestern Colombia before turning toward the Pacific. Its warm lowlands contrast with the cooler mountains around them. Indigenous communities inhabited the valley before Spanish conquest, and colonial estates and mines later drew enslaved Africans into the region. Rivers and mountain paths linked the valley with Popayán and the Pacific coast.

During the colonial centuries people fleeing slavery formed communities in the Patía, including the settlement of El Castigo. Their ties with neighbouring free and enslaved communities included trade and kinship. In 1734 an official pardon recognized some fugitives in the valley, but colonial control remained uneven. The history of the Patía reflects both the coercion of slavery and the efforts of its inhabitants to secure freedom and build communities.
simp_chinese:
帕蒂亚河穿过哥伦比亚西南部安第斯山脉之间的干燥谷地，然后转向太平洋。温暖低地与周围凉爽山地形成对照。西班牙征服之前，原住民社群已居住在谷地；殖民庄园和矿区后来将被奴役的非洲人带到这里。河流与山路将谷地同波帕扬及太平洋海岸相连。

殖民时代，逃离奴役的人们在帕蒂亚建立社群，其中包括埃尔卡斯蒂戈聚落。他们与邻近自由人及被奴役社群之间建立贸易和亲属关系。1734年的官方赦免承认了谷地部分逃亡者，但殖民控制仍不均衡。帕蒂亚的历史既反映奴役的强制，也展现居民争取自由、建立社群的努力。

english: The Patiri were a small Atakapan-speaking people of southeastern Texas. Their country lay in the forested ground between the Bidai and the Akokisa, and their language placed them among the Atakapan groups of the region, with whom they were recorded together. From 1749 to 1751 Patiri people were recorded at San Ildefonso mission on the San Gabriel River, alongside Akokisa, Bidai and Deadose. The mission was short-lived, and after it the Patiri no longer appear as a separate people; they probably merged into the Bidai and Akokisa. People called Petaro, met by La Salle's expedition in the same area in the late seventeenth century, were probably the same people.
simp_chinese: 帕蒂里人是得克萨斯东南部说阿塔卡帕语的小民族。他们的土地位于比代人与阿科基萨人之间的林地，其语言使他们归入该地区的阿塔卡帕语群体，并常与这些群体一同出现在记载中。1749至1751年，帕蒂里人与阿科基萨、比代和迪多斯人一同出现在圣加夫列尔河畔的圣伊尔德丰索传教区。传教区存在时间很短，此后帕蒂里人不再作为单独的民族出现，他们可能并入了比代人和阿科基萨人。十七世纪末拉萨尔远征队在同一带遇到的佩塔罗人（Petaro），很可能就是他们。

english:
Patnagarh was the capital of the Chauhan kingdom of Patna in western Odisha. Its temples include the shrine of Patneswari, the kingdom’s tutelary goddess, and the nearby shrine of Kosaleswara Shiva. A raised platform near the temple is remembered as a throne of the old rulers.

In the fourteenth century Ramai Deo founded the Chauhan kingdom and brought a cluster of neighbouring garhs, or fortified domains, under his authority. His family’s worship of the goddess became associated here with Patneswari, while the older Shaiva shrine continued to be honoured. Later the land north of the Ang River passed to Balaram Deo, who established the kingdom of Sambalpur. The growth of that neighbouring state altered the balance among the Chauhan houses, but Patnagarh remained closely identified with the older Patna line.
simp_chinese:
巴特纳加尔是奥里萨西部乔汉王朝巴特纳王国的都城。城中寺庙包括供奉王国守护女神的帕特内什瓦里寺，以及附近的拘萨罗湿婆神庙。寺旁一座高台被视为旧时统治者的王座。

十四世纪，拉迈·德奥建立乔汉王国，使周围一群称为加尔的设防领地归于他的权威之下。家族对女神的崇拜在这里与帕特内什瓦里相联系，较早的湿婆神庙也继续受到尊崇。后来，安格河以北的土地交给巴拉拉姆·德奥，他建立了森伯尔布尔王国。邻邦的壮大改变了乔汉各支之间的力量平衡，但巴特纳加尔仍与较早的巴特纳王室紧密相连。

english: In the Allegheny highlands, long parallel ridges divide the country around Monterey into a series of mountain valleys. The Monacan and Shawnee hunted in these hills before European settlers entered the region around 1745. German families moved into the northern valleys, while Scots-Irish settlers found land farther south. By the late eighteenth century a few cabins stood at the place known as Bell's Place, in the valley that would later take the name Monterey.
simp_chinese: 在阿勒格尼高地，平行延伸的山岭将蒙特雷周围分成一系列山谷。欧洲移民约于1745年进入这里之前，莫纳坎人和肖尼人已在山地狩猎。德意志家庭迁入北部谷地，苏格兰—爱尔兰移民则在更南方寻找土地。到十八世纪末，后来称为蒙特雷的谷地中已有几座小木屋，聚居处当时称为贝尔地。

english: Patoqua is the Patoka River, a winding tributary of the lower Wabash that flows west through wooded lowlands. Its name is thought to derive from a Miami-Illinois word also recorded as a personal name. A trail between the Ohio River and Vincennes crossed the Patoka near a settlement that took the river's name. The town was laid out in 1813, as American settlement expanded into the river country of the Piankashaw and their neighbors.
simp_chinese: 帕托夸即帕托卡河，这条沃巴什河下游支流蜿蜒向西，流经森林低地。其名称可能来自迈阿密—伊利诺伊语中一个也见于人名的词。连接俄亥俄河与文森斯的小径在一处以河流命名的聚落附近穿过帕托卡河。1813年，当美国定居向皮安卡肖人及邻族的河流地区扩张时，这座城镇开始规划建设。

english: The Patom country lies in the highlands east of the Lena, where forested ridges feed rivers running towards the great Siberian waterway. The Bolshoy Patom rises in the highlands and enters the Lena from the right; the smaller Maly Patom joins nearby. Rapids and stony shallows break the course of the Bolshoy Patom, whose tributaries drain a mountainous landscape of long winters and short summers.
simp_chinese: 帕托姆地区位于勒拿河以东的高地，森林覆盖的山脊孕育河流，流向这条西伯利亚大河。大帕托姆河发源于高地，从右岸汇入勒拿河；较小的小帕托姆河在附近汇入。急流与多石浅滩使大帕托姆河的河道变得崎岖，支流排泄着这片冬长夏短的山地。

english: Patos belongs to the river country feeding the great lagoon of that name in southern Brazil. The Taquari joins the Jacuí, whose waters continue through the Guaíba towards the lagoon. Portuguese authorities organised a settlement of Azorean families on the Taquari in the 1760s. Known as São José de Tebiquary, it stood on a water route connecting the interior with the coastal basin and the Portuguese settlements farther east.
simp_chinese: 帕图斯位于流入巴西南部同名大潟湖的河流地区。塔夸里河汇入雅库伊河，河水经瓜伊巴继续流向潟湖。十八世纪六十年代，葡萄牙当局在塔夸里河畔组织亚速尔家庭定居。聚落称为圣若泽德特比夸里，位于连接内陆、沿海盆地及更东面葡萄牙聚落的水路上。

sources.title: Plano de Gerenciamento Integrado de Resduos Slidos  volume II.pdf

english: The coast beside Lagoa dos Patos is a long sandy barrier between the Atlantic and the shallow waters of southern Brazil’s great lagoon. Rivers enter the lagoon from inland, while its southern outlet at Rio Grande connects it to the ocean. Wind and waves shape the exposed shore, in contrast to the quieter waters and wetlands behind the barrier.
simp_chinese: 帕图斯湖附近的海岸是一条漫长沙障，分隔大西洋与巴西南部大湖的浅水。河流从内陆注入湖中，南端里奥格兰德出口将湖泊与海洋连接。风浪塑造暴露的海岸，与沙障后方较平静的水域和湿地形成对照。

english: Lagoa dos Patos is an immense shallow lagoon in southern Brazil, separated from the Atlantic by a long sandy barrier. The Guaíba and its tributary rivers supply water at the northern end, while the southern outlet at Rio Grande connects the lagoon with the sea. Fresh and salt water meet particularly in its lower reaches, forming an extensive estuarine environment.
simp_chinese: 帕图斯湖是巴西南部一座广阔浅水潟湖，漫长沙障将它与大西洋分开。瓜伊巴湖及其支流从北端供水，南端里奥格兰德出口则连接海洋。淡水与海水尤其在下游交汇，形成广阔的河口环境，周围水域与湿地共同构成南方海岸独特的景观。

english: Patpatar lies on New Ireland, the long island separated from New Britain by St George’s Channel. Its forested hills rise above a coastline inhabited by communities speaking several distinct languages, including Patpatar. In 1767 Philip Carteret sailed through the channel and recognised New Ireland as an island separate from New Britain, whose eastern end had previously been mistaken for part of the same land.
simp_chinese: 帕特帕塔尔位于新爱尔兰岛，圣乔治海峡将这座狭长岛屿与新不列颠岛隔开。森林山岭俯瞰海岸，沿岸社群使用帕特帕塔尔语等不同语言。1767年，菲利普·卡特雷特驶过海峡，确认新爱尔兰是独立的岛屿，而非此前误认为与新不列颠相连的陆地。

english:
Patras stands at the foot of Mount Panachaikon, looking across the gulf that bears its name. Its harbour connects the northern Morea with the Ionian Sea, while a castle overlooks the town. In Roman times Patras was a flourishing city; Christian tradition holds that the apostle Andrew was martyred here. After the Fourth Crusade it became the seat of a Latin archbishop and a barony of the Frankish Principality of Achaea.

The Despotate of the Morea recovered Patras in 1430, but Sultan Mehmed II took it in 1458. The Ottomans called it Baliabadra, or Old Patras, to distinguish it from another town of the same name. Venetian and Genoese attacks disturbed the port, and Venice held it during the Morean War and its aftermath, from 1687 to 1715. In 1770 the city suffered severely when Ottoman forces and their allies suppressed the revolt encouraged by the Russian Orlov expedition. A Russian and Ottoman naval battle followed off its coast in 1772.
simp_chinese:
帕特雷坐落在帕纳哈伊孔山麓，面向以它命名的海湾。港口将摩里亚北部与伊奥尼亚海相连，城堡则俯瞰着城镇。罗马时代的帕特雷曾是一座繁荣的城市；基督教传统认为使徒安德烈在此殉道。第四次十字军东征后，这里成为拉丁大主教驻地，也是法兰克亚该亚公国一个男爵领的中心。

摩里亚专制国于1430年收复帕特雷，但苏丹穆罕默德二世在1458年攻占了它。奥斯曼人称此地为巴利阿巴德拉，即“老帕特雷”，以区别另一座同名城镇。威尼斯和热那亚的进攻屡次袭扰港口，摩里亚战争期间及其后，威尼斯于1687至1715年统治此地。1770年，奥斯曼军队及其盟友镇压受俄国奥尔洛夫远征鼓动的起义，城市遭到严重破坏。1772年，俄国与奥斯曼舰队又在近海交战。

english:
Patsaliga belongs to the river and woodland country of southern Alabama. Patsaliga Creek is a tributary of the Conecuh River, part of a network of streams running through the region. Forests and waterways offered resources to Indigenous communities, while paths linked neighbouring valleys and settlements.

Across the wider Southeast, Indigenous towns and communities maintained relationships through kinship, ceremony and exchange. European contact brought new goods and markets, alongside epidemics, warfare and the trade in captives. Communities responded through migration, alliances and changes in political organization as colonial settlement placed increasing pressure on their lands.
simp_chinese:
帕察利加位于阿拉巴马南部的河流与林地之间。帕察利加溪是科内库河的支流，属于流经这一地区的水系。森林和水道为原住民社群提供资源，小径则连接邻近的河谷与聚落。

在更广阔的北美东南部，原住民城镇和社群通过亲属、仪式和交换保持联系。欧洲人到来后，新的商品与市场伴随疫病、战争和俘虏贸易而来。面对殖民定居对土地的不断挤压，社群通过迁徙、结盟和调整政治组织作出回应。

english:
Pattani was a Malay port and sultanate on the eastern coast of the peninsula, where the Pattani River meets the Gulf of Siam. Its harbour drew merchants from across maritime Asia, and its court became a centre of Malay and Islamic culture. The kingdom maintained relations with Ayutthaya to the north while trading with ships from China, Japan and the lands farther west.

Beginning in 1584 Pattani was ruled by a succession of queens, among them Raja Hijau, Raja Biru, Raja Ungu and Raja Kuning. Their reigns coincided with a flourishing period of commerce and diplomacy, though relations with Siam could be strained. In 1786 a Siamese army conquered Pattani. Further resistance followed, and after another defeat in 1808 Siam divided the old kingdom into smaller principalities, changing the political landscape of the Malay south.
simp_chinese:
北大年是马来半岛东岸的港口和苏丹国，位于北大年河注入暹罗湾之处。港口吸引海上亚洲各地商人，宫廷成为马来与伊斯兰文化中心。王国与北方大城保持关系，同时与来自中国、日本及更西方的船只贸易。

1584 年起，北大年由一系列女王统治，其中包括绿女王、蓝女王、紫女王和黄女王。她们在位期间商业和外交繁荣，与暹罗的关系却时有紧张。1786 年，暹罗军队征服北大年，此后仍发生抵抗；1808 年再次战败后，暹罗将旧王国分为若干小邦，改变了马来南方的政治格局。

english:
Patti rises above Sicily's northern coast, overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea and the Aeolian Islands. Its cathedral of Saint Bartholomew stands on the heights of the town, beside the site of a Benedictine monastery founded under Count Roger. Queen Adelaide, Roger's widow and mother of King Roger II, was buried here after her death in 1118.

In 1399 the diocese of Patti gained full autonomy. The cathedral and the bishopric gave the town an important place in the religious life of this part of Sicily. Its position near the sea also exposed it to attack: in 1544 Hayreddin Barbarossa's forces sacked and burned Patti. Its cathedral was rebuilt after the destruction, preserving the memory of the Norman queen through repeated changes to the building.
simp_chinese:
帕蒂建在西西里北岸的高地上，俯瞰第勒尼安海与埃奥利群岛。圣巴尔多禄茂主教座堂位于镇上高处，毗邻罗杰伯爵时期建立的本笃会修道院遗址。罗杰的遗孀、国王罗杰二世之母阿德莱德王后于1118年去世后葬于此地。

1399年，帕蒂教区取得完全自治。大教堂与主教座使它在这片西西里土地的宗教生活中占有重要地位。临海的位置也使城镇容易遭到攻击：1544年，海雷丁·巴巴罗萨的部队劫掠并焚烧帕蒂。大教堂毁后重建，建筑虽屡次改变，仍保存着对诺曼王后的记忆。

english: South of the central Caroline Islands, the open Pacific surrounds scattered coral atolls west of Chuuk. Outer-island communities maintained connections with Yap through sawei voyages and exchange. Archaeological finds of Yapese pottery on eastern islands point to contacts reaching back several centuries.
simp_chinese: 加罗林群岛中部以南，开阔太平洋环绕楚克以西零散的珊瑚环礁。外围岛屿社群通过萨韦航行和交换与雅浦维持联系。东部岛屿发现的雅浦陶器显示，这些接触可追溯数百年。

english: Pattiw, or the Western Islands, is the westernmost part of Chuuk in the Caroline Islands. Its three islands or atolls, Houk, Poluwat and Pollap, cover only about seven square kilometres together, but they stand on wide reef banks. Poluwat lies at the northwest corner of the Uranie Bank of about 322 square kilometres, and Houk marks the south-eastern point of the Manila Reef of about 332 square kilometres.
simp_chinese: 帕蒂即西部群岛，是加罗林群岛中楚克（Chuuk）最西端的部分。其三座岛屿或环礁霍克、普卢瓦特和波拉普合计陆地面积约七平方公里，却坐落在宽阔的礁台之上：普卢瓦特位于面积约322平方公里的乌拉尼浅滩西北角，霍克则标示着面积约332平方公里的马尼拉礁的东南端。

english: West of Chuuk, the Pacific lies between low atolls of the Caroline Islands and Yap. Voyagers maintained relationships through sawei, an exchange network linking Yap with islands to the east. Yapese pottery found on eastern atolls shows the deep history of these contacts.
simp_chinese: 楚克以西的太平洋位于加罗林群岛低矮环礁与雅浦之间。航海者通过萨韦维持关系，这一交换网络将雅浦与东部岛屿相连。东部环礁发现的雅浦陶器显示了这些接触的悠久历史。

english: Pattukkottai lies south of Thanjavur, in the low country near the Kaveri delta. Its name recalls a fort built in 1686–87 by Vanaji Pandithar, a subordinate of the Maratha ruler Shahuji of Thanjavur. The fortified settlement grew in importance under the Thanjavur Marathas, who had established their rule after the Nayak dynasty. Pattukkottai later came under British authority along with the surrounding Thanjavur country.
simp_chinese: 帕图科泰位于坦贾武尔以南、靠近高韦里河三角洲的低地。它的地名令人想起1686至1687年间修建的一座堡垒，建造者瓦纳吉·潘迪塔尔是坦贾武尔马拉塔统治者沙胡吉的属臣。马拉塔人在纳亚克王朝之后统治坦贾武尔，这座设防聚落在他们治下逐渐兴盛。帕图科泰后来随周边坦贾武尔地区一起归入英国统治。

english:
The Patuxent flows between the Potomac and Patapsco rivers to Chesapeake Bay. Indigenous people lived along its banks long before English settlement; at Pig Point, traces of dwellings and pottery reveal a long history of habitation and exchange in the region. The river's Algonquian name has several proposed meanings, including “place where tobacco grows.”

John Smith mapped the river as Pawtuxunt after travelling upstream in 1608. English settlements later spread along its banks, and by 1705 the Patuxent Iron Works was shipping iron downriver. In 1814, during the war with Britain, Commodore Joshua Barney's Chesapeake Bay Flotilla was trapped in the river. His men destroyed their vessels to prevent their capture, and British troops landed farther downstream at Benedict before marching on Washington.
simp_chinese:
帕图克森特河在波托马克河与帕塔普斯科河之间流向切萨皮克湾。英国人定居以前很久，原住民便居住在河岸；皮格角发现的房屋遗迹与陶器见证了当地悠久的居住和交流历史。河名来自阿尔冈昆语，有多种解释，其中一种是“烟草生长的地方”。

约翰·史密斯于1608年沿河而上，在地图上将其标作波图克森特。此后英国聚落逐渐沿河扩展，到1705年帕图克森特铁厂已沿河运出生铁。1814年英美战争期间，约书亚·巴尼准将的切萨皮克湾船队被困在河中，部下为防船只被俘而将其炸毁；英军则在下游的贝内迪克特登陆，随后向华盛顿进军。

english:
Patuxet was a Wampanoag community on the coast of Massachusetts, at the site where Plymouth would later be founded. Its people were among the Indigenous inhabitants first encountered by Europeans in the early seventeenth century. An epidemic of infectious disease devastated the community before the arrival of the English settlers who crossed the Atlantic Ocean on the Mayflower.

The settlers established Plymouth in 1620. Tisquantum, also known as Squanto, had belonged to Patuxet and became an intermediary between the newcomers and the Wampanoag. His knowledge helped the struggling colony survive, but he died in 1622. Plymouth's early years depended on relationships with neighbouring Indigenous communities as the newcomers established themselves on the coast and built their settlement at the former village site.
simp_chinese:
帕图克塞特是马萨诸塞海岸的万帕诺亚格社群，后来普利茅斯便建在这里。十七世纪初，欧洲人来到这一带时，他们是最早与欧洲人接触的原住民之一。在乘“五月花”号横渡大西洋的英国移民到来之前，传染病流行已重创这个社群。

移民于1620年建立普利茅斯。蒂斯匡特姆又称斯匡托，曾是帕图克塞特社群的一员，后来成为新来者与万帕诺亚格人之间的中间人。他的知识帮助艰难求生的殖民地渡过难关，但他于1622年去世。普利茅斯建立初期，移民在原来的村址上建起聚落，在海岸站稳脚跟，有赖于与邻近原住民社群的关系。

english:
Pátzcuaro stands above the southern shore of the lake that bears its name, in the heartland of the Purépecha. Tradition remembers it as an early centre of their kingdom, associated with the ruler Tariácuri. Its name has been interpreted as the place of temples, recalling the sacred buildings that marked the lakeside landscape.

After the Spanish conquest, Vasco de Quiroga, the first bishop of Michoacán, made Pátzcuaro his seat in 1540. He founded the College of San Nicolás and planned an ambitious cathedral with five naves converging on a central altar. The city became a religious and political centre of the province, though the cathedral project was never completed as originally intended. In 1580 the civil and ecclesiastical authorities moved to Valladolid. Pátzcuaro nevertheless remained a centre of the lake communities and a place closely associated with the memory of Quiroga.
simp_chinese:
帕茨夸罗坐落在同名湖的南岸高地，是普雷佩查人的核心地区。传统将它记为王国早期中心，与统治者塔里亚库里相联系。其名称被解释为“神庙之所”，令人想起湖畔众多的圣殿。

西班牙征服后，米却肯首任主教巴斯科·德·基罗加于1540年将主教座堂迁至帕茨夸罗。他创办圣尼古拉斯学院，并规划一座雄伟大教堂，五条中殿汇向中央祭坛。城市成为全省宗教与政治中心，但教堂最终未能按原计划建成。1580年，民政和教会当局迁往巴利亚多利德。帕茨夸罗仍是湖区社群的中心，也与基罗加的记忆紧密相连。

english: Lake Pátzcuaro lies in the volcanic highlands of Michoacán, surrounded by the towns of the Purépecha heartland. Islands including Janitzio rise from its waters, while wooded hills frame the shore. Pátzcuaro, Ihuatzio and Tzintzuntzan were important centres around the lake before the Spanish conquest. Their communities used the lake as a source of food and a route between settlements, and their history is closely tied to its shores.
simp_chinese: 帕茨夸罗湖位于米却肯火山高地，周围环绕普雷佩查核心地区的城镇。哈尼齐奥等岛屿从水中升起，森林覆盖的丘陵环抱湖岸。西班牙征服前，帕茨夸罗、伊瓦齐奥和钦聪灿是湖边的重要中心。各社群以湖泊为食物来源，也利用水路往返聚落，地方历史与湖岸息息相关。

sources.title: Plan Manejo Turistico taller de manejo de 2009 subcuencas patzcuaro.pdf

english: Pau stands above the Gave de Pau, facing the peaks of the Pyrenees. Its castle became the residence of the rulers of Béarn, and in 1464 Pau succeeded Orthez as their capital. After the rulers of Navarre were driven from Pamplona in 1512, they found refuge in their Béarnais lands and at Pau. Jeanne d'Albret gave birth here in 1553 to Henri of Navarre, the future Henri IV of France. The castle remained a centre of government through the religious struggles of his age. In 1620 Louis XIII came to Pau and had an edict registered joining Béarn and Navarre to the French crown, ending their separate political institutions.
simp_chinese: 波城坐落在波河上方，面向比利牛斯群峰。城堡成为贝阿恩统治者的住所，1464年，波城取代奥尔泰兹成为首府。1512年，纳瓦拉统治者被逐出潘普洛纳后，在贝阿恩领地及波城寻求庇护。1553年，让娜·达尔布雷在此生下纳瓦拉的亨利，也就是未来的法国国王亨利四世。在他所处时代的宗教纷争中，城堡仍是政府中心。1620年，路易十三来到波城，登记敕令，将贝阿恩和纳瓦拉并入法国王室领地，结束其独立的政治地位。

english: Paucartambo stands beside the Mapacho River east of Cusco, where the highlands descend toward the forested eastern slopes of the Andes. During Spanish rule it served as the center of a district that supplied Cusco with maize, coca, wheat and other produce. In the eighteenth century a stone bridge named for King Charles III replaced an older wicker bridge, joining the town across the river and giving the mountain settlement one of its most distinctive landmarks.
simp_chinese: 保卡尔坦博位于库斯科以东的马帕乔河畔，安第斯高地在此向东侧森林坡地下降。西班牙统治时期，它是一个辖区的中心，向库斯科供应玉米、古柯、小麦等物产。十八世纪，一座以国王卡洛斯三世命名的石桥取代了旧有的柳条桥，跨河连接城镇，也成为这座山城最鲜明的地标之一。

english: Paunacussing Creek flows northeast through the wooded hills of eastern Pennsylvania to the Delaware River. A short stream with a steep descent, it joins the larger river opposite an island in the Delaware. The Lenape lived in this country before English settlement, and the creek appeared in a colonial land survey in 1703. Mills were later built along its course, using the water that falls toward the river.
simp_chinese: 保纳库辛溪向东北流过宾夕法尼亚东部林木覆盖的丘陵，汇入特拉华河。这条短溪落差较大，在特拉华河一座岛屿对面注入大河。英国人定居以前，莱纳佩人生活在这一地区；1703年的殖民土地测量记录了这条溪流。后来溪流沿岸建起磨坊，利用落向大河的水流作为动力。

english: Paungde lies south of Prome in the lowlands between the Irrawaddy and the Pegu Yoma. The surrounding country contains villages, fields and Buddhist shrines linked by streams and seasonal waters. At nearby Thegon, a pagoda standing amid water is associated in local legend with the founding of ancient Sri Ksetra. Rest houses on the embankments served pilgrims who came to worship there. The wider region belonged to the river country through which travellers passed between Upper and Lower Burma.
simp_chinese: 庞德位于卑谬以南，处在伊洛瓦底江与勃固山脉之间的低地。周围村落、田野和佛教圣所由溪流与季节性水道相连。附近代贡有一座水中佛塔，当地传说将它与古室利差呾罗的建城故事联系起来。堤岸上的歇脚亭供前来礼佛的朝圣者使用。这片河流地带也是往来上缅甸和下缅甸的旅人所经过的地区。

english: Pauzhetka lies in a river valley at the northwestern foot of the Kambalny Range in southern Kamchatka. The Pauzhetka flows into the Ozernaya, while hot springs rise from the volcanic ground beside it. Steam, bubbling water and small muddy pools mark the thermal field. The eighteenth-century explorer Stepan Krasheninnikov described the hot waters flowing into the river during his travels through the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 保热特卡位于堪察加南部坎巴利内山脉西北麓的一处河谷。保热特卡河汇入奥泽尔纳亚河，河畔火山地层中涌出温泉，蒸汽、翻涌的泉水和小泥池标志着这片地热区。十八世纪探险家斯捷潘·克拉舍宁尼科夫游历半岛时，曾记述流入河中的热水。

english: Pavagada stands beneath a hill fort in the southern Deccan, where Kannada and Telugu country meet. The temple of Kote Anjaneya lies at the foot of the hill. After the defeat of Vijayanagara in 1565, local Nayaka chiefs rose to prominence in the region. Pavagada's ruling line began with Ballappa Nayaka, associated with the construction of its fort, while nearby Penukonda became a seat of the surviving Vijayanagara dynasty.
simp_chinese: 帕瓦加达位于德干南部的山堡脚下，地处卡纳达和泰卢固地区相接之处。山麓有一座科特·安贾内亚神庙。1565年毗奢耶那伽罗战败后，当地纳亚克首领在这一地区兴起。帕瓦加达的统治家族由巴拉帕·纳亚克开创，堡垒的修建也与他有关；附近的佩努孔达则成为延续下来的毗奢耶那伽罗王朝驻地。

english: Pavlohrad lies on the Vovcha in the Samara river basin, in the steppe east of the Dnipro. Its beginnings are associated with a Zaporozhian Cossack wintering place, around which the military sloboda of Matviivka was established in 1775. It was later called Luhanska, then received the name Pavlohrad and town status in 1784. Cossacks from the Samara and Kalmius districts were among the early inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 巴甫洛赫拉德位于第聂伯河以东草原上的沃夫查河畔，属于萨马拉河流域。它的起源与一处扎波罗热哥萨克冬营地有关；1775 年，军事斯洛博达马特维伊夫卡在营地周围建立。聚落后来称为卢汉斯卡，1784 年获得巴甫洛赫拉德之名和城镇地位。早期居民中有来自萨马拉和卡利米乌斯地区的哥萨克。

english: Pavlovo stands on the high bank of the Oka, where the river bends through the wooded country west of Nizhny Novgorod. A royal charter of 1566 refers to the village and its inhabitants' fishing rights in the lakes of the Oka floodplain. Pavlovo also became known for metalworking: a survey counted eleven smithies in 1621, and the craft grew around the river settlement. Its smiths supplied tools and other iron goods to a much wider market.
simp_chinese: 帕夫洛沃坐落在奥卡河高岸，河流在下诺夫哥罗德以西的林地中转弯。1566年的沙皇敕书提及村庄，以及居民在奥卡河泛滥平原湖泊中的捕鱼权。帕夫洛沃也以金属加工闻名：1621年的调查在此记录了11座铁匠铺，手工业围绕沿河聚落发展。铁匠制造工具及其他铁器，销往更广阔的市场。

english: Pavlovskaya lies on the steppe plain north of the Kuban. Its history is tied to the Black Sea Cossacks, who moved to the region in the 1790s and established settlements named for their kurens. The Pavlovsky kuren was among them. In 1822 its inhabitants were moved to land belonging to a wealthy livestock owner named Ason, establishing the settlement at the site associated with Pavlovskaya.
simp_chinese: 帕夫洛夫斯卡亚位于库班河以北的草原平原。它的历史与黑海哥萨克有关：十八世纪九十年代，哥萨克迁入这一地区，建立以各自库连命名的聚落，帕夫洛夫斯基库连便是其中之一。1822 年，居民迁到富有的牧场主阿松的土地上，在后来与帕夫洛夫斯卡亚相联系的地点建立聚落。

english: Pavón lies on the eastern side of the entrance to Golfo Dulce, a deep inlet on the Pacific coast of southern Costa Rica. The Osa Peninsula shelters the opposite shore, while the waters near Pavones remain open to swells arriving from the Pacific. Forested hills, streams and coastal beaches frame this entrance between the gulf and the sea.
simp_chinese: 帕翁位于杜尔塞湾入口的东岸。杜尔塞湾是哥斯达黎加南部太平洋海岸的一处深海湾，对岸受到奥萨半岛的庇护，而帕沃内斯附近的水域仍面向来自太平洋的涌浪。林木覆盖的山丘、溪流和海滩环绕着海湾与大洋之间的入口。

english:
The Pawcatuck flows from the Great Swamp to Little Narragansett Bay, through a country of ponds, woods and coastal waters. Its lower banks formed part of Misquamicut, home to Narragansett people before English settlement. The river's fish drew communities to its shores, while the mouth opened onto the waters of Long Island Sound.

Thomas Stanton built a trading house on the river in 1649, and for many years controlled trade near its mouth. In 1660 a group from Newport acquired land at Misquamicut, and English settlement took root on the eastern bank the following year. Westerly was incorporated in 1669, when the surrounding area contained about thirty English families. The Pawcatuck also became a boundary between competing colonial claims, eventually marking the division between Rhode Island and Connecticut.
simp_chinese:
波卡塔克河从大沼泽流向小纳拉甘西特湾，穿过湖泊、森林与近海水域交错的地区。河流下游两岸属于米斯夸米卡特，在英国殖民者定居之前是纳拉甘西特人的家园。河中的鱼群吸引居民来到岸边，河口则通向长岛海峡。

1649年，托马斯·斯坦顿在河畔建起贸易屋，多年来控制着河口附近的贸易。1660年，一群纽波特人取得米斯夸米卡特的土地，次年英国移民开始在东岸定居。1669年韦斯特利建镇，当时周围地区约有三十户英国人家。波卡塔克河也成为殖民地之间争夺领土的界线，后来划分了罗得岛与康涅狄格。

english: Pawir, also called Chope, lay near the Nile in northern Bunyoro. Traditions of its Palwo inhabitants recall an early migration across the river under Nyawir, followed by settlements between Lake Albert, the Nile and the Kafu. Their chiefs bore the title rwot, and members of the ruling clan established neighbouring communities. Later accounts remember further migrations and a famine that disrupted Pawir's settlement, carrying some of its people into other parts of northern Bunyoro.
simp_chinese: 帕维尔又称乔佩，位于布尼奥罗北部的尼罗河附近。当地帕卢奥人的传统记述，一支早期迁徙群体在尼亚维尔带领下渡河，随后在艾伯特湖、尼罗河与卡富河之间建立聚落。首领使用鲁奥特的称号，统治氏族的成员又建立了邻近社群。后来的记述还记得进一步的迁徙，以及打乱帕维尔聚落的饥荒；部分居民因此前往布尼奥罗北部其他地区。

english: Pawwikamsipi is the Little Wabash River, which winds south through the Illinois prairie to join the Wabash. Its valley lies within a landscape long used by the Piankashaw and other peoples of the Wabash country. In the early nineteenth century Piankashaw families lived on land between the Little Wabash and the Embarras that they considered their reservation. The river's course through low ground and woodland connects those inland lands with the larger waterway to the east.
simp_chinese: 帕维卡姆西比即小沃巴什河，河水蜿蜒南流，穿过伊利诺伊草原后汇入沃巴什河。河谷属于皮安卡肖人及沃巴什地区其他民族长期利用的土地。十九世纪初，皮安卡肖家庭居住在小沃巴什河与安巴拉河之间的一片土地上，他们视其为自己的保留地。河流穿过低地和森林，将这片内陆土地与东面更大的水道连接起来。

sources.title: indian villages il country wayne temple.pdf

english: Tsiis Tl’edze’ Caegge is the Ahtna name for Chistochina, a community in the upper Copper River country. The Chistochina River joins the Copper from the east, below the mountain country used by Ahtna families for hunting and travel. Salmon ascending the Copper and its tributaries sustained fishing camps, while trails connected the basin with the upper Tanana and neighbouring regions. The Ahtna named the rivers, lakes and mountains of their homeland in great detail, preserving knowledge of the places through which they travelled.
simp_chinese: 齐斯特莱杰凯格是奇斯托奇纳的阿特纳语名称。这处社群位于铜河上游地区，奇斯托奇纳河从东面汇入铜河，河流上方的山地是阿特纳家庭狩猎与旅行的地方。溯游进入铜河及支流的鲑鱼为渔营提供食物，道路则将盆地与塔纳纳河上游和邻近地区相连。阿特纳人为家园中的河流、湖泊和山脉留下细致的名称，保存了对旅经各处的认识。

english:
Paxtang grew near a crossing of the Susquehanna River, where trails converged at the Indigenous village of Peshtank. The name has been interpreted as “where the waters stand.” In 1714 the French trader Peter Bisaillon received permission to build at Peshtank or another settlement on the river, as colonial trade and settlement expanded into the valley.

A Presbyterian congregation was organised at Paxtang in 1732, and a stone church followed in 1740. During Pontiac's War, settlers known as the Paxton Boys attacked the Conestoga people in December 1763, killing twenty unarmed men, women and children at their settlement and in Lancaster, where survivors had been placed in protective custody. The following year the group marched toward Philadelphia but dispersed after negotiations with a delegation including Benjamin Franklin.
simp_chinese:
帕克斯唐发展于萨斯奎哈纳河一处渡口附近，多条小径在原住民村庄佩什坦克汇合。这个名字被解释为“水停驻之处”。1714年，法国商人彼得·比萨永获准在佩什坦克或河上的另一处聚落建造房屋，殖民贸易和定居正向河谷扩展。

1732年，当地组织了长老会会众，1740年又建起石教堂。庞蒂亚克战争期间，被称为帕克斯顿男孩的移民于1763年12月袭击科内斯托加人，在其聚落及兰开斯特杀害了二十名手无寸铁的男女和儿童；兰开斯特的幸存者原已受到保护性拘押。次年，这群人向费城进军，在与包括本杰明·富兰克林在内的代表团谈判后散去。

english:
La Paya stands where a stream of the same name meets the Calchaquí River, south of Cachi. Its stone enclosures, paths and burial places belonged to a large and substantial settlement in the northern Calchaquí valley. Among its buildings is the Casa Morada, a rectangular structure of carefully worked reddish sandstone distinguished by its Inca design.

The settlement was occupied before Inca expansion and continued to bear signs of imperial influence. The Casa Morada was built within the local settlement, while pottery and metal objects found among its buildings also show links to the wider Inca world. Archaeologists have proposed that La Paya was an important local centre and may have served the administration of the Inca province of Chicoana.
simp_chinese:
拉帕亚位于同名溪流与卡尔查基河交汇处，在卡奇以南。石砌围屋、道路和墓葬属于卡尔查基河北段一座规模可观的聚落。其中的“紫屋”是一座以精加工红色砂岩修建的长方形建筑，其印加式设计十分醒目。

这座聚落在印加扩张之前就有人居住，此后也留下了帝国影响的痕迹。紫屋建在当地聚落之内，建筑之间发现的陶器和金属器同样显示了与更广阔的印加世界的联系。考古学家认为拉帕亚是重要的地方中心，并提出它可能服务于印加奇科阿纳省的行政管理。

english: Payacullo is a highland territory of the Qhara Qhara people in the southern Bolivian Andes. Its communities are organised in ayllus, groups whose lands and relationships connect settlements across the mountain country. This was part of the wider landscape of the Qhara Qhara and neighbouring peoples before Inca and Spanish rule altered the political order of the region.
simp_chinese: 帕亚库约是玻利维亚南部安第斯山地中卡拉卡拉人的土地。当地社群以艾尤组织，其土地和关系将山地间的聚落联系起来。印加与西班牙统治改变地区政治秩序以前，这里已属于卡拉卡拉人及其邻人居住的广大地区。

english: The Paiacu were an Indigenous people of the northeastern Brazilian coast and interior, known under several spellings including Baiacu and Payaku. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Portuguese expansion into Ceará and the neighbouring captaincy of Rio Grande brought conflicts and forced movements. Colonial missions gathered Indigenous people into settlements, while the advance of cattle ranching placed growing pressure on their lands.
simp_chinese: 派亚库人是巴西东北部沿海与内陆的原住民族，也以拜亚库、帕亚库等不同拼法见于记载。十七至十八世纪，葡萄牙人向塞阿腊及邻近的里奥格兰德都督区扩张，带来了冲突和强制迁移。殖民传教站将原住民集中到聚落，而牧场的推进使他们的土地面临越来越大的压力。

english: The Payette River descends from mountain lakes and forests to join the Snake, crossing a country used by Shoshone, Nez Perce, Paiute and Bannock peoples. Families travelled between the lower valleys and upland gathering grounds, harvesting camas bulbs and other foods. Controlled burning helped maintain some camas fields. In 1818 a party of fur traders named the river for their companion François Payette, bringing a new name to a waterway already known to its Indigenous inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 佩耶特河从山间湖泊与森林流向蛇河，穿过肖肖尼人、内兹珀斯人、派尤特人和班诺克人利用的土地。家庭往返于下游谷地与高处采集地之间，采挖卡马斯球茎及其他食物；有控制的焚烧有助于维持一些卡马斯生长地。1818年，一队毛皮商人以同伴弗朗索瓦·佩耶特之名为河流命名，为原住民早已熟悉的水道增添了新名称。

english: Paykend lies in the Kyzylkum desert northwest of Bukhara, near the Kara-Kir sands. Desert vegetation grows among the dunes, providing cover and food for the Cape hare, which ranges across this part of the Bukhara desert. The sandy country lies beyond the cultivated oases of the lower Zarafshan, where water disappears into the desert.
simp_chinese: 沛肯德位于布哈拉西北的克孜勒库姆沙漠，靠近卡拉基尔沙地。沙丘间生长着荒漠植被，为出没于布哈拉荒漠的好望角兔提供食物和隐蔽之处。这片沙地在泽拉夫善河下游耕作绿洲之外，河水在此消失于沙漠之中。

english: The Payómkawichum, or People of the West, lived in the valleys and coastal country of southern California. Their villages and lands later came to be associated with the name Luiseño, after the Spanish mission of San Luis Rey. Founded in 1798 within their ancestral territory, the mission brought new demands for labour and conversion. The Payómkawichum continued to maintain their communities under difficult conditions as colonial institutions changed the use of their land.
simp_chinese: 帕约姆卡维丘姆意为“西方人”，居住在加利福尼亚南部的谷地与海岸。西班牙人建立圣路易斯雷传教站后，他们的村落和土地又与“路易塞尼奥”这个名称联系在一起。传教站于1798年建在他们的祖地之内，带来劳动与改宗的新要求。殖民机构改变土地用途的同时，帕约姆卡维丘姆人在艰难条件下继续维持社群。

english: Payubre is the old name of the country around Mercedes, near the stream of the same name in the plains of Corrientes. In the late eighteenth century cattle estates appeared between the Payubre Grande and neighbouring watercourses. Settlers near the stream petitioned for a town in 1825. A church was begun in 1832 and dedicated to Our Lady of Mercy in 1835, when the growing settlement acquired the name Mercedes.
simp_chinese: 帕尤布雷是科连特斯平原上梅塞德斯附近地区的旧称，得名于同名溪流。十八世纪末，帕尤布雷格兰德溪与邻近水道之间出现了牧牛庄园。1825年，溪流附近居民请求建立城镇。教堂于1832年动工，1835年奉献给仁慈圣母，逐渐发展的聚落也因此得名梅塞德斯。

english: Payzawat lies east of Kashgar on the western fringe of the Taklamakan. Its irrigated oasis occupies the plain between rivers descending from the Tian Shan and the desert beyond. The name appears in Qing documents, when the district was governed from Kashgar. Fields and orchards depended on channels that brought water across the dry plain, allowing communities to cultivate land at the edge of the sands.
simp_chinese: 排孜阿瓦提位于喀什以东、塔克拉玛干沙漠西缘。灌溉绿洲坐落在天山来水与沙漠之间的平原上。清代文献已有此名，当时这一地区归喀什噶尔官员管辖。渠道将水引过干燥平原，滋养田地和果园，使居民得以在沙海边缘耕作。

english:
Pazhaverkadu, known to Europeans as Pulicat, stands on the Coromandel coast at the southern end of a long, shallow lagoon. Its port drew merchants to the textile-producing country of southern India and to the sea routes of the Bay of Bengal. The Portuguese established a trading post here in 1502 with the help of the local Vijayanagara rulers and built a fort to defend it.

The Dutch took the fort in 1609 and made Pulicat the capital of their Coromandel possessions until 1690. Their trade included the forced export of people from the coast to slavery in Batavia, as well as the exchange of textiles. The town changed hands repeatedly in the contests between European powers; it was occupied by the British in 1825.
simp_chinese:
帕扎维拉卡杜在欧洲记录中称为普利卡特，位于科罗曼德尔海岸一片狭长浅潟湖的南端。港口吸引商人前往印度南部的织物产区，也通向孟加拉湾航路。1502年，葡萄牙人在毗奢耶那伽罗统治者的帮助下设立商站，并修建堡垒保护它。

荷兰人于1609年夺取堡垒，直到1690年一直以普利卡特为其科罗曼德尔领地的首府。他们的贸易包括纺织品，也包括把沿海居民强行贩往巴达维亚为奴。此后城镇在欧洲势力争夺中多次易手，1825年被英国占领。

english:
In the heart of Istria, Pazin's castle stands on the edge of the deep chasm into which the Pazinčica River disappears. The stronghold became the seat of the Counts of Gorizia and the center of a county that encompassed much of inland Istria. While Venice acquired towns along the coast, Pazin and its hinterland passed to the Habsburgs in 1374, leaving the peninsula divided between rival powers.

The Habsburgs entrusted Pazin to a succession of noble families and appointed captains to administer the estate. Its position made it vulnerable when Austria and Venice went to war: Venetian forces captured the town in 1508, and another conflict brought a destructive attack on Old Pazin in 1616. After that war the Habsburgs sold the estate, which continued to pass between noble owners through much of the 18th century.
simp_chinese:
在伊斯特里亚腹地，帕津城堡矗立在深渊边缘，帕津奇察河从下方消失于地下。堡垒曾是戈里齐亚伯爵的驻地，也是一个涵盖伊斯特里亚大片内陆的伯国中心。威尼斯取得沿海城镇之时，帕津及其腹地于1374年转归哈布斯堡家族，使半岛分属两大竞争势力。

哈布斯堡家族先后将帕津交给多个贵族家族，并任命官员管理领地。奥地利与威尼斯交战时，这一位置使它容易受到攻击：威尼斯军队于1508年占领城镇，另一场战争又于1616年给老帕津带来毁灭性的袭击。战后，哈布斯堡家族出售了这片领地，此后直到18世纪的大部分时间里，它仍在贵族所有者之间转手。

english:
Peam, later known as Hà Tiên, grew into a trading port on the Gulf of Siam at the western edge of the Mekong delta. Its harbour connected the waterways of Cambodia with maritime routes across Southeast Asia. Merchants and settlers of different origins gathered here, and the port became a meeting place for the interests of Cambodia, Siam and the Nguyễn rulers of southern Vietnam.

In the late seventeenth century the Chinese adventurer Mạc Cửu established his authority in the area. Threatened by Siamese and Cambodian rivals, he pledged allegiance to the Nguyễn lord in 1708. His son Mạc Thiên Tứ succeeded him in 1735 and developed Hà Tiên into a flourishing entrepôt. The family maintained its position through diplomacy and commerce amid the rivalries of neighbouring powers.
simp_chinese:
边后来称为河仙，发展为湄公河三角洲西缘暹罗湾畔的贸易港。港口将柬埔寨水道与横贯东南亚的海路连接起来。不同出身的商人和移民汇聚于此，使这座海港成为柬埔寨、暹罗与越南南方阮主利益交会的重要地方。

十七世纪末，华人冒险者莫玖在当地建立势力。面对暹罗和柬埔寨对手的威胁，他于 1708 年向阮主效忠。其子莫天赐于 1735 年继位，将河仙发展为繁盛的转口港。莫氏家族在邻国争斗之间通过外交和贸易维持自己的地位。

english: Pearl Lagoon opens to the Caribbean on Nicaragua's coast, with mangroves and river mouths around its brackish waters. Kukra communities once lived along the lagoon and the coast between it and the Río Grande. In the later seventeenth century, the region's history was changed by the arrival of Africans brought to the Americas as enslaved people and by the southward expansion of Miskito groups allied with English raiders. The Kukra population was eventually absorbed or dispersed.
simp_chinese: 珍珠潟湖通向尼加拉瓜海岸外的加勒比海，半咸水周围分布红树林与河口。库克拉社群曾居住在潟湖及其与格兰德河之间的海岸。十七世纪后半叶，被奴役并带到美洲的非洲人来到这一地区；与英国袭掠者结盟的米斯基托人也向南扩张，改变了当地历史。库克拉人口最终被吸纳或流散。

english: Lingdingyang is the broad estuary through which the Pearl River reaches the sea. Islands and channels lead north towards Guangzhou, while the waters around Tuen Mun guard approaches from the open coast. In 1521 a Ming fleet under Wang Hong attacked Portuguese vessels near Tuen Mun. After months of fighting, three Portuguese ships escaped in a storm, leaving the estuary in Ming hands.
simp_chinese: 伶仃洋是珠江入海的宽阔水域，岛屿与航道向北通往广州，屯门附近海面则扼守海上入口。1521年，明朝水师在汪鋐率领下于屯门附近进攻葡萄牙船队。交战数月后，三艘葡船趁暴雨逃走，明军守住了这片河口水域。

english: Pewenmapu is the high Andean country of the pewen, the araucaria tree whose large seeds have long been an important food for the Pehuenche people. Forests of these trees grow on the mountain slopes, beneath snow-covered peaks and volcanoes. The territory formed a distinct mountain division of the Mapuche world, beyond the foothills and plains to the west. Seasonal movement through valleys and passes connected communities on either side of the cordillera.
simp_chinese: 佩文马普是安第斯高山上的“佩文之地”，得名于南洋杉；这种树的大粒种子长期以来是佩文切人的重要食物。南洋杉林生长在积雪峰峦和火山下的山坡上。这片土地构成马普切世界中独特的山区，与西面的山麓和平原相邻。沿河谷和山口的季节性往来，将山脉两侧的社群联系起来。

english: Peçanha lies in the wooded hills of eastern Minas Gerais, in the basin of the Suaçuí Grande. News of gold drew an expedition led by João Peçanha Falcão and the priest Francisco Martins to the region in 1758. A mining camp and chapel grew into the settlement of Santo Antônio do Peçanha. The surrounding forests were already inhabited by Indigenous communities as colonial prospectors advanced into the valleys.
simp_chinese: 佩萨尼亚位于米纳斯吉拉斯东部林木覆盖的丘陵中，属于苏阿苏伊格兰德河流域。黄金的消息吸引若昂·佩萨尼亚·法尔康和弗朗西斯科·马丁斯神父于1758年率队来到这里。采矿营地和小教堂发展成圣安东尼奥杜佩萨尼亚聚落。殖民寻矿者进入河谷时，周围森林中早已有原住民社区居住。

english: The Pecatonica River rises in the hills west of the upper Rock River and winds south and east through prairie and woodland before joining it. Its name is derived from Algonquian words meaning slow water. During the Black Hawk War of 1832, an encounter at Horseshoe Bend on the Pecatonica became known as the Battle of the Pecatonica. Militiamen attacked a group of Kickapoo there on 16 June, amid the fighting that spread across the Rock River country.
simp_chinese: 佩卡托尼卡河源于罗克河上游以西的丘陵，穿过草原与森林，蜿蜒向南再向东流入罗克河。河名源自阿尔冈昆语，意为缓慢的水。1832年黑鹰战争期间，佩卡托尼卡河马蹄湾的一场交战被称为佩卡托尼卡战役。6月16日，民兵在此袭击了一支基卡普人队伍，战火已遍及罗克河地区。

english: The Pecatonica rises among the hills of southwestern Wisconsin and flows south into the Rock River country. Its name comes from an Algonquian expression meaning “slow water.” Along its long, winding course the river receives an eastern branch and, farther downstream, the Sugar River before joining the Rock. The waters ultimately reach the Mississippi, linking the wooded uplands and open country of the upper river to the great valley in the west.
simp_chinese: 佩卡托尼卡河发源于威斯康星西南部的丘陵，向南流入罗克河地区。河名来自阿尔冈昆语，意为“缓慢的水”。漫长曲折的河道先汇入东支流，更下游又接纳舒格河，最后与罗克河相会。水流最终抵达密西西比河，将上游的林地高地与开阔土地连接到西方的大河谷。

english: The Pech are an Indigenous people of northeastern Honduras, whose homeland extended between the Aguán and Patuca rivers during the colonial era. Their language belongs to the Chibchan family, whose other members are spoken farther south in Central America. From the seventeenth century, pressure from Miskito groups on the Caribbean coast drove some Pech communities toward the rivers and inland valleys, including the country around Olancho.
simp_chinese: 佩奇人是洪都拉斯东北部的原住民族；殖民时期，他们的家园分布在阿瓜恩河与帕图卡河之间。佩奇语属于奇布查语系，该语系的其他语言多见于更南方的中美洲。自十七世纪起，加勒比海岸米斯基托人的压力促使部分佩奇社区迁向河流上游和内陆谷地，其中包括奥兰乔一带。

english:
Pechenga lies by a river and inlet on the northern coast of the Kola Peninsula, in a country inhabited by Sámi communities. In 1533 the monk Tryphon founded the Monastery of the Holy Trinity on the Pechenga, seeking to bring Christianity to the local Skolt Sámi. By 1572 it housed about fifty monks and two hundred lay followers, a northern outpost linked to both the sea and the inland fishing grounds.

In 1589 a Swedish raid burned the wooden monastery and killed many of its inhabitants. Tsar Fyodor ordered the community re-established near Kola in 1591, but the new hermitage also burned in 1619. The monastery was later moved into Kola itself and ultimately dissolved in 1764. The Pechenga river and bay remained landmarks of a contested northern frontier.
simp_chinese:
佩琴加位于科拉半岛北岸的河流和海湾旁，当地长期有萨米社群居住。1533年，修士特里丰在佩琴加河边创建圣三一修道院，意图向当地斯科尔特萨米人传播基督教。到1572年，修院约有五十名修士和二百名俗人，是连接海洋与内陆渔场的北方据点。

1589年，瑞典袭击者焚毁木修道院，许多居民遇害。1591年，沙皇费奥多尔下令在科拉附近重建团体，但新隐修院于1619年再次毁于火灾。修道院后来迁入科拉城中，最终于1764年解散。佩琴加河与海湾仍是北方争夺地带的重要地标。

english: Pechichitane was a name associated with the valley where León later grew, on the northern edge of the Bajío. Guamares and other Chichimeca peoples inhabited the surrounding country before Spanish settlement expanded into the region. During the Chichimeca War, conflict spread across the roads and estates of this frontier. The Spanish founded the Villa de León in 1576, seeking a foothold in the contested lands north of the settled valleys.
simp_chinese: 佩奇奇塔内是后来莱昂城所在山谷的旧名，与巴希奥北缘有关。西班牙人扩张到这里以前，瓜马雷人和其他奇奇梅克民族居住在周围地区。奇奇梅克战争期间，冲突遍及边疆的道路和庄园。西班牙人于 1576 年建立莱昂镇，希望在定居谷地以北的争夺地区建立据点。

english: The Pechora rises in the northern Urals and flows through forest and tundra toward the Arctic sea. Its upper course is swift and stony; farther downstream it widens across a lowland, receiving the Ilych, Northern Mylva, Izhma and Usa among many tributaries. Komi settlers founded a village at the mouth of the Northern Mylva in 1674, while Mansi had previously used the upper river country. The Pechora continues northward through a broad floodplain before dividing into channels in its delta.
simp_chinese: 伯朝拉河发源于北乌拉尔，穿过森林和苔原流向北冰洋。上游水流湍急、河床多石；下游进入低地后河面变宽，汇入伊雷奇河、北梅尔瓦河、伊日马河和乌萨河等众多支流。此前曼西人曾使用上游地区，1674年科米移民在北梅尔瓦河口建立村庄。伯朝拉河继续向北流经广阔泛滥平原，在三角洲分为多条河道。

english:
Pécs lies at the southern foot of the Mecsek hills, on the site of the Roman town of Sopianae. Beneath the city are painted burial chambers and memorial chapels of an early Christian cemetery. King Stephen founded a bishopric here in 1009, and the cathedral and its clergy made Pécs an enduring religious centre of southern Hungary.

In 1367 King Louis I founded a university at Pécs, the first in Hungary. The city later became a centre of humanist learning under its bishop Janus Pannonius, a celebrated Latin poet whose patronage helped make the episcopal city a centre of art as well as scholarship. Its prosperity was interrupted by Ottoman invasion: after Mohács in 1526 the town was plundered and burned, and in 1543 it opened its gates to the Ottoman army.

Under Ottoman rule churches became mosques and new baths, religious schools and tombs changed the city's appearance. The mosque of Pasha Qasim rose in the central square, while a Sufi monastery was established at Tettye, alongside the schools and institutions serving the Muslim community. Pécs also remained a busy market town, and the Ottoman historian İbrahim Peçevi took his name from his native city. Habsburg forces captured Pécs in 1686. As churches and civic institutions were restored, buildings from its Ottoman century and a half remained part of the cityscape.
simp_chinese:
佩奇位于梅切克山南麓，建在罗马城镇索皮亚奈的旧址上。城市地下有早期基督教墓地的彩绘墓室与纪念礼拜堂。1009年，伊什特万国王在此建立主教区，主教座堂和教士使佩奇长期成为匈牙利南部的宗教中心。

1367年，路易一世国王在佩奇创办匈牙利第一所大学。后来，这座城市在主教亚努斯·潘诺尼乌斯治下成为人文主义学术中心；他也是著名的拉丁语诗人，其赞助使主教驻地既成为学术中心，也成为艺术中心。奥斯曼入侵打断了繁荣：1526年摩哈奇战役后，城镇遭掠夺焚烧，1543年又向奥斯曼军队开门投降。

奥斯曼统治下，教堂被改为清真寺，新建的浴场、宗教学校和陵墓改变了城市面貌。卡西姆帕夏清真寺矗立在中央广场，泰蒂耶还建起一座苏菲派修院，与其他学校和机构一起服务于穆斯林社区。佩奇仍是一座繁忙的集镇，奥斯曼史家易卜拉欣·佩切维也以故乡得名。1686年，哈布斯堡军队攻占佩奇。教堂和市政机构恢复的同时，奥斯曼统治一个半世纪留下的建筑仍是城市景观的一部分。

english: Pecunktuk, or Otter Creek, winds northward through western Vermont to Lake Champlain. Its Indigenous name has been explained as “crooked river,” while another Abenaki name referred to the otter. The river served as a route between communities in the valley and the lake country, and early English settlers called it the Indian Road. In 1690 Albany commissioned Abraham Schuyler to take a party up the lower river to watch for and engage Indigenous people; European settlement expanded along the valley in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 佩昆克图克河，又称水獭溪，蜿蜒向北流过佛蒙特西部，注入尚普兰湖。其原住民名称被解释为“曲折的河”，另一个阿贝纳基名称则与水獭有关。这条河是河谷与湖区社群之间的通道，早期英国移民称其为“印第安人之路”。1690年，奥尔巴尼委派亚伯拉罕·斯凯勒率队进入河流下游，监视并攻击原住民；十八世纪，欧洲移民沿河谷不断扩展定居。

english: The northern coast of Flores faces the Flores Sea, with mountains and volcanoes rising inland. Bays and small islands break the shore along the island's length, while the waters to the north lead towards Sulawesi. Flores forms part of the long volcanic chain of the Lesser Sundas, west of the islands of Solor and Alor.
simp_chinese: 弗洛勒斯岛北岸面向弗洛勒斯海，内陆耸立着山脉和火山。海湾与小岛使沿岸线曲折，北方水域通向苏拉威西。弗洛勒斯是小巽他群岛漫长火山岛链的一部分，位于索洛尔和阿洛尔诸岛以西。

english: Peddapalli was a coastal settlement in the Krishna country, known to Dutch merchants as Petapoly and to the English as Pettipolee. It had been ruled by the Velanati Chodas before passing under Golconda. The Dutch traded here from 1606, and the English East India Company established a factory in 1621. The English post closed in 1687, when factories subordinate to Fort St George were withdrawn.
simp_chinese: 佩达帕尔利是克里希纳地区的一处海岸聚落，荷兰商人称之为佩塔波利，英国人则称佩蒂波利。这里曾由韦拉纳蒂朱罗统治，后来归属戈尔康达。荷兰人从1606年起在此贸易，英国东印度公司于1621年设立商馆。1687年，圣乔治堡辖下的商馆撤离，英国人在此的商站也随之关闭。

english: The Salar de Pedernales spreads across a high basin in the dry southern Andes. Its broad crust of salt and shallow lagoons lie beneath the mountains of the Cordillera Claudio Gay. Despite the severity of the climate, wetlands at the edges of the salar support birdlife, including flamingos. Streams and underground waters collect in this closed basin, where evaporation leaves minerals on the surface.
simp_chinese: 佩德纳莱斯盐沼铺展在干燥南安第斯的一处高原盆地，广阔盐壳与浅湖位于克劳迪奥盖山脉之下。尽管气候严酷，盐沼边缘的湿地仍为包括火烈鸟在内的鸟类提供栖息地。溪流和地下水汇集于这个封闭盆地，水分蒸发后，矿物留在地表。

english: Pedersöre is one of the old parishes of Ostrobothnia, stretching from the coast of the Gulf of Bothnia into the interior. It was named in a royal letter concerning trading rights in 1348. Over time its extensive territory gave rise to other parishes. In 1652 a town was established on its coast; Ebba Brahe named it Jakobstad after her late husband Jakob de la Gardie.
simp_chinese: 佩德舍勒是博滕古老的教区之一，从波的尼亚湾海岸延伸至内陆。1348年一封有关贸易权的王室信函提到了这里。随着时间推移，广阔的教区分出其他教区。1652年，沿海建立了一座城镇，埃巴·布拉赫以亡夫雅各布·德拉加迪的名字将其命名为雅各布斯塔德。

english: Pedra Furada is a natural rock arch on the coast of Ceará near Jericoacoara. Waves have worn an opening through the rock, leaving a distinctive landmark beside the Atlantic. Rocky headlands interrupt the beaches and dunes of this exposed shore, where wind moves sand along the coast and the sea continually works against the stone. The arch stands where the dry backlands approach the ocean.
simp_chinese: 富拉达洞石是塞阿拉州热里科阿科阿拉附近海岸的一座天然石拱。海浪在岩石中侵蚀出孔洞，留下大西洋岸边醒目的地标。岩石岬角打断了这片暴露海岸上的沙滩与沙丘；风沿岸搬运沙粒，海水不断冲刷岩石。石拱所在的地方，干旱腹地几乎延伸至海洋。

english: Pedraza stands within walls on a rocky height in the Segovian uplands, its castle guarding the approach to the old town. The fortress belonged to the Fernández de Velasco family, constables of Castile. After Francis I of France was captured at Pavia, his two sons were sent to Spain as hostages for the fulfilment of his agreements with Charles V. The young princes spent several months at Pedraza under the constable's custody, making the castle part of a struggle between Europe's rival monarchs.
simp_chinese: 佩德拉萨坐落在塞哥维亚高地的岩丘上，城墙环绕镇子，城堡守卫着通往老城的道路。堡垒属于担任卡斯蒂利亚统帅的费尔南德斯·德贝拉斯科家族。法国国王弗朗索瓦一世在帕维亚被俘后，他的两个儿子被送往西班牙作为履行与查理五世协议的人质。年轻王子在统帅监护下于佩德拉萨住了数月，使这座城堡卷入欧洲君主间的争斗。

english: The Pedirka Desert is a dry inland region north of Lake Eyre, with sand dunes and sparse vegetation between the Simpson and Sturt Stony deserts. It lies within a much larger landscape of Aboriginal country where routes, water places and seasonal knowledge connect the desert with neighbouring lands. Rainfall is rare, and dry channels can carry water only after exceptional storms.
simp_chinese: 佩迪尔卡沙漠是艾尔湖以北的干旱内陆地区，沙丘和稀疏植被分布在辛普森沙漠与斯特尔特石漠之间。它属于更广阔的原住民土地，道路、水源地和季节知识将沙漠与邻近地区联系起来。这里降雨稀少，干涸河道只有在异常暴雨后才可能行水。

english: Pedroche lies in the high country north of Córdoba, on an old route towards Toledo. It was the centre of a community of town and dependent villages that became known as the Seven Towns of Los Pedroches.
